abaddon_death_coil.description: Releases a coil that heals an ally or damages an enemy at the cost of Abaddon's own health.
abaddon_death_coil.coaching_tip: Use Mist Coil to deny yourself when low to prevent enemy kills; also strong for lane harass since self-damage can trigger Borrowed Time.

abaddon_aphotic_shield.description: Surrounds a unit with a shield that absorbs damage and dispels debuffs, exploding for AoE damage when destroyed or expired.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.coaching_tip: Cast preemptively to dispel stuns on initiation; recast immediately when the shield breaks for continuous protection.

abaddon_frostmourne.description: Attacks slow the target and after multiple hits apply a silence and grant allied movement speed.
abaddon_frostmourne.coaching_tip: Focus one target to proc the silence quickly; the ally speed boost helps your team chase down fleeing enemies.

abaddon_borrowed_time.description: When activated or triggered below a health threshold, all damage heals Abaddon instead for the duration.
abaddon_borrowed_time.coaching_tip: Let it trigger automatically to bait enemies into wasting burst; avoid activating manually too early.

alchemist_acid_spray.description: Sprays acid over an area, reducing armor and dealing damage over time to enemies within.
alchemist_acid_spray.coaching_tip: Use on creep waves and jungle camps for fast farming; place under enemy melee cores in fights for armor reduction.

alchemist_unstable_concoction.description: Brews an explosive that stuns and damages based on brew time. Explodes on Alchemist if not thrown.
alchemist_unstable_concoction.coaching_tip: Start brewing from fog so enemies cannot see the timer; throw at 3-4 seconds for optimal stun without risking self-stun.

alchemist_goblins_greed.description: Grants bonus gold per last hit, stacking and increasing with rapid successive kills.
alchemist_goblins_greed.coaching_tip: Maximize stacks by clearing jungle camps and waves in quick succession; rush farming items early to exploit the gold snowball.

alchemist_chemical_rage.description: Transforms Alchemist with massive HP regen, reduced base attack time, and bonus movement speed.
alchemist_chemical_rage.coaching_tip: Activate before fights so regen is already ticking; the low BAT makes attack speed items exceptionally efficient.

ancient_apparition_cold_feet.description: Places a debuff that stuns the target after a delay if they stay within the area.
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.coaching_tip: Combo with allied slows or stuns to guarantee the freeze; without lockdown, enemies simply walk away.

ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.description: Creates a vortex that slows enemies and amplifies magic damage they take. Provides vision.
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.coaching_tip: Place before casting other spells to amplify magic damage; also useful for scouting Roshan or high ground.

ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.description: Empowers attacks with bonus magic damage and range at the cost of attack speed.
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.coaching_tip: Use to harass safely in lane with the extra range; lets you trade favorably against most supports.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.description: Launches a global tracer that expands into an AoE blast, dealing damage and preventing all healing. Enemies below a threshold shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.coaching_tip: Counter high-sustain heroes like Alchemist and Huskar; release early for precision or let it travel for larger AoE.

antimage_mana_break.description: Each attack burns mana and deals bonus physical damage based on the mana burned.
antimage_mana_break.coaching_tip: Most effective against mana-dependent heroes; build attack speed to burn mana faster and cripple casters.

antimage_blink.description: Short distance teleportation for repositioning in and out of combat.
antimage_blink.coaching_tip: Use Blink between jungle camps for efficient farming; at max level 6s CD makes you extremely hard to catch.

antimage_counterspell.description: Passively grants magic resistance. Activating creates an anti-magic shell that reflects targeted spells.
antimage_counterspell.coaching_tip: Anticipate key targeted spells and activate to reflect them; reflecting a big stun can turn a fight entirely.

antimage_mana_void.description: Deals AoE damage based on the target's missing mana with a brief stun.
antimage_mana_void.coaching_tip: Burn mana with attacks first, then Mana Void for massive AoE; target intelligence heroes with large mana pools.

arc_warden_flux.description: Infuses a target with a damaging slowing field, dispelled if another allied hero is nearby.
arc_warden_flux.coaching_tip: Most effective on isolated targets; use when enemies are separated from teammates for full duration.

arc_warden_magnetic_field.description: Creates a field granting evasion against ranged attacks and bonus attack speed to allies within.
arc_warden_magnetic_field.coaching_tip: Place around yourself or carry during fights to negate ranged attacks; also works on buildings for tower defense.

arc_warden_spark_wraith.description: Summons a wraith that patrols and chases the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage on contact.
arc_warden_spark_wraith.coaching_tip: Stack Spark Wraiths at chokepoints or jungle camps for zone control; multiple wraiths burst down squishy heroes quickly.

arc_warden_tempest_double.description: Creates a perfect copy with all abilities and items off cooldown. Cannot gain gold or XP.
arc_warden_tempest_double.coaching_tip: Use the Double aggressively while keeping the main hero safe; items like Midas can be used on both copies.

axe_berserkers_call.description: Taunts all nearby enemies to attack Axe while gaining bonus armor. Pierces spell immunity.
axe_berserkers_call.coaching_tip: Blink into Call is the classic initiation; pierces BKB making it a top-tier teamfight control ability.

axe_battle_hunger.description: Debuffs a target with DoT and slow, removed when they kill a unit. Axe gains move speed per affected enemy.
axe_battle_hunger.coaching_tip: Cast when enemies have no nearby creeps to last-hit for removal; stacking on multiple enemies gives significant move speed.

axe_counter_helix.description: When attacked, Axe has a chance to spin and deal pure damage to all nearby enemies.
axe_counter_helix.coaching_tip: Cut creep waves between towers to trigger Counter Helix frequently; this is also how Axe jungles efficiently.

axe_culling_blade.description: Instantly kills an enemy below a health threshold. Successful kills grant team movement and attack speed.
axe_culling_blade.coaching_tip: Watch kill thresholds (250/350/450 HP); successful kills give your team a speed boost for chasing.

bane_enfeeble.description: Weakens an enemy, reducing their status resistance and healing received.
bane_enfeeble.coaching_tip: Cast on enemy cores before disables to extend stun durations; heal reduction is strong against sustain heroes.

bane_brain_sap.description: Drains health from an enemy dealing pure damage and healing Bane for the same amount.
bane_brain_sap.coaching_tip: Pure damage and self-heal make it excellent for lane trading; keeps you healthy while harassing.

bane_nightmare.description: Puts a target to sleep with 1s invulnerability then disabling them. Transfers to attackers.
bane_nightmare.coaching_tip: Use to set up long-windup stuns like Sacred Arrow; warn allies not to attack the sleeping target.

bane_fiends_grip.description: Channels on a target, disabling them and draining mana while dealing damage. Pierces spell immunity.
bane_fiends_grip.coaching_tip: Position safely before channeling; the BKB-piercing hold makes Bane invaluable against magic-immune carries.

batrider_sticky_napalm.description: Drenches an area in napalm, slowing and adding bonus damage per stack to Batrider's damage sources.
batrider_sticky_napalm.coaching_tip: Stack aggressively in lane to make every attack and Firefly tick devastating; 3-4 stacks make trading impossible for the enemy.

batrider_flamebreak.description: Hurls a molotov that explodes on impact, knocking back enemies and dealing DoT.
batrider_flamebreak.coaching_tip: Use to push enemies into bad positions or cancel channels; combos well with Napalm stacks for burst.

batrider_firefly.description: Takes flight leaving a fire trail that damages enemies. Grants flying movement over terrain.
batrider_firefly.coaching_tip: Activate to chase over cliffs and trees; apply Napalm before flying over enemies for massive trail damage.

batrider_flaming_lasso.description: Lassoes an enemy, disabling and dragging them. Pierces spell immunity.
batrider_flaming_lasso.coaching_tip: Blink in, Lasso a key target, then Force Staff to drag them to your team; pierces BKB for guaranteed pickoffs.

beastmaster_wild_axes.description: Throws two axes in an arc that return, dealing damage and stacking a damage amp debuff.
beastmaster_wild_axes.coaching_tip: Aim so both passes hit the same targets for double damage; use to clear jungle camps and waves efficiently.

beastmaster_call_of_the_wild_boar.description: Summons a boar companion that slows enemies with each attack.
beastmaster_call_of_the_wild_boar.coaching_tip: Send the boar to harass laners or scout; the slow helps set up kills and the boar tanks jungle creeps.

beastmaster_inner_beast.description: Passively grants bonus attack speed to all nearby allied units including summons.
beastmaster_inner_beast.coaching_tip: Stay near your carry during fights for the aura; it also speeds up Roshan attempts and tower pushes.

beastmaster_primal_roar.description: Stuns and damages the target while pushing aside and slowing enemies in a line. Pierces spell immunity.
beastmaster_primal_roar.coaching_tip: Use to lock down BKB cores since it pierces spell immunity; the long cast range allows initiation without Blink.

bloodseeker_bloodrage.description: Enrages a unit granting bonus attack speed and spell amp, but also amplifying damage taken.
bloodseeker_bloodrage.coaching_tip: Cast on yourself before fights for the spell amp bonus; be careful when enemies have burst since you take amplified damage.

bloodseeker_blood_bath.description: Creates a ritual area that silences and deals pure damage after a delay.
bloodseeker_blood_bath.coaching_tip: Place where enemies are forced to stay, such as on a Ruptured target; the silence is devastating against casters.

bloodseeker_thirst.description: Passively grants move speed and attack damage based on enemy heroes' missing health globally.
bloodseeker_thirst.coaching_tip: When allies trade damage across the map, you gain speed and damage; use this to dominate your lane or gank.

bloodseeker_rupture.description: Deals damage based on the distance an enemy moves. Pierces spell immunity.
bloodseeker_rupture.coaching_tip: Target mobile heroes like Anti-Mage or Storm Spirit; combine with Blood Rite to force them to take one damage type.

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.description: Hurls a shuriken dealing damage and ministunning. Bounces to all Tracked units nearby.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.coaching_tip: Track multiple enemies before throwing for maximum bounces; the ministun cancels TPs and channels.

bounty_hunter_jinada.description: Periodically empowers the next attack with bonus damage and steals gold from the target.
bounty_hunter_jinada.coaching_tip: Time attacks to proc Jinada for gold steal and harass; it adds up to significant economic disruption.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.description: Becomes invisible with bonus move speed. Breaking invis with an attack deals bonus damage.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.coaching_tip: Use to roam between lanes for ganks; scout wards and courier movements while invisible.

bounty_hunter_track.description: Tracks an enemy providing true sight and allied move speed. Killing tracked targets grants bonus gold.
bounty_hunter_track.coaching_tip: Track every enemy before fights for the gold bounty and speed; true sight counters invis-reliant heroes.

brewmaster_thunder_clap.description: Slams the ground dealing damage and slowing movement and attack speed of nearby enemies.
brewmaster_thunder_clap.coaching_tip: Use in lane to secure last hits and harass simultaneously; the attack speed slow is strong for melee trades.

brewmaster_cinder_brew.description: Drenches enemies in alcohol, slowing them. Magic or fire damage ignites them for bonus DoT.
brewmaster_cinder_brew.coaching_tip: Cast before Thunder Clap to guarantee the ignite proc for maximum damage; combos with any ally fire damage.

brewmaster_drunken_brawler.description: Passively grants dodge chance and crit chance. Can toggle between stances.
brewmaster_drunken_brawler.coaching_tip: Toggle evasion stance when tanking and crit stance when dealing damage; the dodge makes Brew durable in lane.

brewmaster_primal_split.description: Splits into three elemental spirits with unique abilities. Brewmaster reforms at the last surviving spirit.
brewmaster_primal_split.coaching_tip: Activate when about to die to split and reset; Earth stun and Storm cyclone provide powerful crowd control.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.description: Sprays goo on a target reducing armor and move speed, stacking multiple times.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.coaching_tip: Keep stacking on one target for heavy armor and speed reduction; combined with Quill Spray the physical damage is devastating.

bristleback_quill_spray.description: Sprays quills in all directions dealing physical damage. Subsequent hits on the same target stack bonus damage.
bristleback_quill_spray.coaching_tip: Spam constantly in extended fights since stacking damage becomes enormous; never stop casting during prolonged engagements.

bristleback_bristleback.description: Reduces damage from behind and sides. After taking threshold damage from behind, automatically releases Quill Spray.
bristleback_bristleback.coaching_tip: Turn your back to enemies to reduce damage and trigger free Quill Sprays; avoid facing enemies head-on.

bristleback_warpath.description: Each spell cast grants a stack of bonus move speed and attack damage.
bristleback_warpath.coaching_tip: Alternate Quill Spray and Nasal Goo rapidly to build Warpath stacks; at full stacks you become extremely fast and powerful.

broodmother_insatiable_hunger.description: Grants bonus damage and lifesteal for a duration.
broodmother_insatiable_hunger.coaching_tip: Activate when diving or fighting to sustain through enemy damage; the lifesteal lets you manfight most heroes.

broodmother_spin_web.description: Spins a web that grants Broodmother bonus movement speed, health regen, and free pathing within.
broodmother_spin_web.coaching_tip: Spread webs across the enemy jungle to dominate their side of the map; free pathing lets you escape through trees and cliffs.

broodmother_incapacitating_bite.description: Attacks slow enemies and have a chance to miss, reducing their effectiveness.
broodmother_incapacitating_bite.coaching_tip: The miss chance and slow make Broodmother strong in 1v1 fights against right-click carries; press the advantage in webs.

broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.description: Injects a target with spiderlings that burst out on death, spawning controllable spiders.
broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.coaching_tip: Use on lane creeps and jungle camps to build a spider army; the army provides push power and scouting but is vulnerable to AoE.

centaur_hoof_stomp.description: Slams the ground stunning and damaging nearby enemies.
centaur_hoof_stomp.coaching_tip: Blink into Stomp is a reliable AoE stun initiation; follow up with Double Edge for burst damage.

centaur_double_edge.description: Deals magic damage to a nearby enemy and to Centaur himself.
centaur_double_edge.coaching_tip: Self-damage is offset by Centaur's high HP pool; use immediately after Hoof Stomp for guaranteed burst.

centaur_return.description: Passively returns damage to attackers based on Centaur's strength.
centaur_return.coaching_tip: Retaliate punishes enemies who attack you; stack strength items to increase the return damage.

centaur_stampede.description: All allied heroes gain max movement speed and trample enemies in their path for a duration.
centaur_stampede.coaching_tip: Use Stampede to initiate, chase, or help allies escape globally; the damage reduction component also saves allies from burst.

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.description: Throws a bolt that stuns and damages with random values - higher stun means lower damage and vice versa.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.coaching_tip: Use as your primary initiation stun; the randomness averages out over time, so don't hesitate to throw it.

chaos_knight_reality_rift.description: Teleports Chaos Knight and all his illusions to the target, reducing the target's armor.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.coaching_tip: Use after Chaos Bolt to pull yourself and illusions onto the stunned target; the armor reduction amplifies your burst.

chaos_knight_chaos_strike.description: Grants a chance to deal critical damage and lifesteal on the attack.
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.coaching_tip: The crit and lifesteal work on illusions, making it core to CK's damage output; Reality Rift ensures all illusions proc simultaneously.

chaos_knight_phantasm.description: Creates several strong illusions of Chaos Knight and dispels all debuffs.
chaos_knight_phantasm.coaching_tip: Phantasm also dispels, so use it to remove silences or stuns; Reality Rift into a stunned target with illusions deals enormous burst.

chen_penitence.description: Slows an enemy and causes them to take bonus damage from attacks.
chen_penitence.coaching_tip: Cast on the target your team is focusing to amplify right-click damage; the slow helps your creeps and allies chase.

chen_holy_persuasion.description: Converts an enemy or neutral creep to fight for Chen, granting it bonus health.
chen_holy_persuasion.coaching_tip: Prioritize converting creeps with powerful abilities like Centaur stomp or Hellbear clap; the right creep army wins lanes and fights.

chen_divine_favor.description: Passively grants bonus health regen to nearby allied heroes and creeps.
chen_divine_favor.coaching_tip: Stay near your lane partner to provide sustain; the regen keeps your carry healthy without spending resources.

chen_hand_of_god.description: Globally heals all allied heroes and Chen's controlled creeps.
chen_hand_of_god.coaching_tip: Use Hand of God to turn fights across the map; the global heal can save allies from lethal damage anywhere.

clinkz_strafe.description: Grants bonus attack speed and a chance to dodge projectile attacks for a duration.
clinkz_strafe.coaching_tip: Activate during fights for the massive attack speed burst; the projectile dodge makes you hard to trade against at range.

clinkz_searing_arrows.description: Adds bonus fire damage to attacks. Can be manually cast to avoid drawing creep aggro.
clinkz_searing_arrows.coaching_tip: Manually cast in lane to harass without drawing aggro; toggling autocast during fights ensures maximum DPS.

clinkz_death_pact.description: Consumes a target creep, gaining bonus health and damage based on the creep's max health.
clinkz_death_pact.coaching_tip: Consume a large creep before fighting or ganking for a significant HP and damage boost; always have Death Pact active.

clinkz_wind_walk.description: Clinkz becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed.
clinkz_wind_walk.coaching_tip: Use to position for ganks and escape after kills; break invis with Searing Arrows active for maximum opening burst.

rattletrap_battery_assault.description: Rapid mini-stuns and damage to the nearest enemy unit in close range over several seconds.
rattletrap_battery_assault.coaching_tip: Use inside Power Cogs to repeatedly ministun a trapped enemy; guaranteed damage if you keep close range.

rattletrap_power_cogs.description: Creates a ring of electrified cogs that trap units inside and push away enemies who touch them.
rattletrap_power_cogs.coaching_tip: Trap priority targets inside cogs with you while keeping their allies out; the mana burn on push can drain support mana.

rattletrap_rocket_flare.description: Fires a global rocket that damages enemies and provides vision at the impact area.
rattletrap_rocket_flare.coaching_tip: Use for global scouting of Roshan, rune spots, and enemy jungle; also great for finishing low-HP fleeing enemies.

rattletrap_hookshot.description: Fires a hookshot that latches onto the first enemy hero hit, pulling Clockwerk to them and stunning.
rattletrap_hookshot.coaching_tip: Use Hookshot to initiate on backline targets from extreme range; immediately follow with Battery Assault and Cogs.

crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.description: Blasts an area with ice dealing damage and slowing attack and movement speed.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.coaching_tip: Use to harass and secure ranged creep last hits in lane; the long slow duration helps set up kills with allies.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.description: Freezes a target in place dealing damage over time. Extended duration against creeps.
crystal_maiden_frostbite.coaching_tip: Reliable single-target root for setting up kills; use on jungle creeps for solo farm since the creep duration is long.

crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.description: Global aura providing mana regeneration to all allied heroes. CM gets an enhanced bonus.
crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.coaching_tip: CM's core value is global mana regen for the team; even one early point helps all lanes sustain their spell usage.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.description: Channels an ice storm around CM dealing massive random damage and slowing nearby enemies.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.coaching_tip: Use with BKB to avoid interruption; position in the middle of the fight for maximum explosions hitting enemies.

dark_seer_vacuum.description: Pulls all enemies in an area to a central point, dealing damage.
dark_seer_vacuum.coaching_tip: Combo Vacuum into Wall of Replica for devastating teamfight initiation; also pairs with ally AoE abilities like Echo Slam.

dark_seer_ion_shell.description: Surrounds a unit with a damage aura that burns nearby enemies.
dark_seer_ion_shell.coaching_tip: Place on melee creeps to push waves and harass enemy laners; cast on allied initiators so they deal passive damage while engaging.

dark_seer_surge.description: Grants maximum movement speed to a target allied unit for a short duration.
dark_seer_surge.coaching_tip: Cast on initiators to help them reach enemies or on allies to help them escape; the max speed burst is uncatchable.

dark_seer_wall_of_replica.description: Creates a wall that creates illusions of enemy heroes who pass through it.
dark_seer_wall_of_replica.coaching_tip: Vacuum enemies through the wall for guaranteed illusions; enemy carry illusions deal real damage and can turn teamfights.

dark_willow_bramble_maze.description: Creates an area of brambles that root enemies who walk into them.
dark_willow_bramble_maze.coaching_tip: Place in chokepoints or where enemies are forced to walk; the scattered roots can lock down an entire team.

dark_willow_shadow_realm.description: Becomes untargetable for a duration. The next attack deals bonus magic damage based on time spent in Shadow Realm.
dark_willow_shadow_realm.coaching_tip: Use defensively to dodge targeted spells, then attack for the bonus damage; let the timer build for maximum burst.

dark_willow_cursed_crown.description: Places a delayed stun on an enemy that also stuns nearby enemies when it triggers.
dark_willow_cursed_crown.coaching_tip: Cast on an enemy near their teammates so the AoE stun hits multiple heroes; combo with Bramble Maze for chain CC.

dark_willow_terrorize.description: Sends Jex to a target area, causing enemies to flee toward their fountain.
dark_willow_terrorize.coaching_tip: Use Terrorize to disrupt enemy positioning in teamfights; enemies forced to run can be picked off by your team.

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.description: Swings her hammer three times, dealing damage in an arc. The final slam stuns.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.coaching_tip: Land the third slam on your target for the stun; animation can be used to close distance while dealing damage.

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.description: Hurls her hammer which deals damage and creates a fire trail, then returns. Can converge to teleport to it.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.coaching_tip: Throw the hammer, then Converge to teleport to its location for gap closing; the fire trail zones enemies in fights.

dawnbreaker_luminosity.description: After a set number of attacks, the next attack heals allied heroes in an area around the attacked unit.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.coaching_tip: Time your powered-up attack to hit when allies are nearby to heal them; Starbreaker swings count toward the attack counter.

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.description: Channels then flies to an allied hero anywhere on the map, healing allies and damaging enemies on landing.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.coaching_tip: Use Solar Guardian to join fights globally; channel from a safe location and land on your team's frontliner for maximum impact.

dazzle_poison_touch.description: Releases a poisonous projectile that deals damage and slows the target over time.
dazzle_poison_touch.coaching_tip: Cast repeatedly in lane to pressure enemies with sustained damage; at max stacks the slow becomes significant for kill setups.

dazzle_shallow_grave.description: Prevents an allied hero from dying for a short duration by keeping them at 1 HP minimum.
dazzle_shallow_grave.coaching_tip: Cast Shallow Grave reactively on dying allies for clutch saves; prioritize your carry and have fast reflexes since it's instant cast.

dazzle_shadow_wave.description: Sends a wave of healing that bounces between allied units, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies for each bounce.
dazzle_shadow_wave.coaching_tip: Stand near creeps and allies to maximize bounces; in grouped-up fights, Shadow Wave heals your team while dealing AoE damage.

dazzle_nothl_projection.description: Passively reduces item cooldowns. Can be activated to reduce enemy armor in an area.
dazzle_nothl_projection.coaching_tip: Bad Juju's item CDR lets you use utility items more frequently; the armor reduction stacks with repeated casts.

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.description: Sends a wave of bats dealing damage in a line.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.coaching_tip: Primary wave clear and poke spell; use to push waves quickly and deal consistent lane harass.

death_prophet_silence.description: Silences all enemy units in a target area.
death_prophet_silence.coaching_tip: Cast on grouped enemies to prevent them from using spells during teamfights; especially effective against combo-reliant heroes.

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.description: Creates a link to an enemy that drains HP based on max health percentage, healing DP. Has charges.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.coaching_tip: Attach siphons to multiple enemies in fights for massive sustained healing; the percentage drain is strong against tanky heroes.

death_prophet_exorcism.description: Releases damaging spirits that attack nearby enemies and structures, returning to heal DP when the ability ends.
death_prophet_exorcism.coaching_tip: Pop Exorcism and run at towers or into teamfights; the spirits damage buildings so push aggressively during its duration.

disruptor_thunder_strike.description: Strikes the target with repeated lightning bolts that also hit nearby enemies and provide vision.
disruptor_thunder_strike.coaching_tip: Cast for vision tracking on fleeing enemies; the repeated strikes also reveal invisible heroes.

disruptor_glimpse.description: Sends an enemy hero back to where they were several seconds ago.
disruptor_glimpse.coaching_tip: Glimpse heroes who just teleported to lane to send them back to base; also useful to pull fleeing enemies back into your team.

disruptor_kinetic_field.description: Creates a barrier that prevents enemies from leaving the area after a short delay.
disruptor_kinetic_field.coaching_tip: Combo with Static Storm to trap enemies inside the silence; place after Glimpse to catch the returning hero.

disruptor_static_storm.description: Creates an electric storm that silences and deals increasing damage to enemies within.
disruptor_static_storm.coaching_tip: Place inside Kinetic Field so enemies cannot escape the silence; with Aghanim's it also mutes items for a complete lockdown.

doom_bringer_devour.description: Consumes a creep, gaining its abilities and bonus gold over time.
doom_bringer_devour.coaching_tip: Devour creeps with powerful abilities like Centaur stomp or Satyr purge; the bonus gold accelerates your farm significantly.

doom_bringer_scorched_earth.description: Burns the ground around Doom, dealing damage to enemies and healing Doom with bonus movement speed.
doom_bringer_scorched_earth.coaching_tip: Toggle on during fights for sustained damage and healing; the movement speed boost helps chase enemies.

doom_bringer_infernal_blade.description: Causes attacks to deal bonus damage based on max HP and apply a brief stun.
doom_bringer_infernal_blade.coaching_tip: The ministun interrupts channels and TPs; the max HP percentage damage is effective against tanky heroes.

doom_bringer_doom.description: Applies a long-duration silence and mute to a target, dealing damage over time. Disables passives.
doom_bringer_doom.coaching_tip: Cast on the enemy's most impactful hero to remove them from the fight; Doom disables passives, items, and spells simultaneously.

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.description: Breathes fire in a cone dealing damage and reducing enemy attack damage.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.coaching_tip: Use to secure last hits and harass simultaneously; the attack damage reduction pressures enemy carries in trades.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.description: Melee stun that gains extended range in Elder Dragon Form.
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.coaching_tip: In dragon form the cast range increases dramatically, making it a powerful ranged stun; use the long stun for initiation or peel.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.description: Passively grants bonus HP regen and armor making Dragon Knight highly durable.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.coaching_tip: The sustain allows DK to stay in lane indefinitely without returning to base; pair with Soul Ring for frequent spell usage.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.description: Transforms into a dragon gaining ranged attack and scaling effects: poison, splash, and frost at each level.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.coaching_tip: Transform and push towers aggressively; level 3 frost dragon is devastating in teamfights. Track the duration carefully.

drow_ranger_frost_arrows.description: Autocast that adds frost to attacks, dealing bonus magic damage and slowing enemies.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.coaching_tip: Manually cast in lane to harass without drawing creep aggro; toggle autocast on during chases for permanent slow.

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.description: Releases a blast of wind that pushes back and silences enemies in a cone.
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.coaching_tip: Key self-defense skill; use preemptively against diving heroes to push them away and silence their abilities.

drow_ranger_multishot.description: Fires waves of arrows in a cone dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.
drow_ranger_multishot.coaching_tip: Choose your angle to hit the maximum number of enemies in fights; also efficient for clearing jungle camps.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.description: Passively grants bonus agility. Attacks have a chance to ignore armor and instantly kill creeps. Disabled when enemies are close.
drow_ranger_marksmanship.coaching_tip: Maintain distance from enemies to keep Marksmanship active; position at maximum range and use Gust to push away divers.

earth_spirit_boulder_smash.description: Kicks a nearby Stone Remnant or enemy unit in the target direction, stunning enemies hit.
earth_spirit_boulder_smash.coaching_tip: Place a remnant then kick it for long-range initiation stun; without a remnant it just pushes the target without stun.

earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.description: Rolls forward in a ball, stunning the first enemy hit. Rolling through a Stone Remnant increases range and stun.
earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.coaching_tip: Roll through a remnant for extended range and stun duration; this is your primary gap closer for initiation.

earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.description: Pulls a Stone Remnant toward Earth Spirit, silencing enemies it passes through.
earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.coaching_tip: Pull a remnant through enemies for the silence; this can also pull remnants to reposition for Boulder Smash combos.

earth_spirit_magnetize.description: Magnetizes nearby enemies, dealing damage over time. Placing remnants near magnetized enemies refreshes and spreads the debuff.
earth_spirit_magnetize.coaching_tip: Place remnants near magnetized targets to refresh and spread the DoT to nearby enemies; can devastate grouped-up teams.

earthshaker_fissure.description: Creates a line of impassable terrain that stuns enemies and blocks movement for 6 seconds.
earthshaker_fissure.coaching_tip: Use Fissure to split the enemy team or block escape routes; be careful not to trap your own allies behind the terrain.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.description: Empowers the next attack with massively multiplied base damage.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.coaching_tip: After Echo Slam, follow up with an Enchant Totem hit for huge burst; max level gives 400% bonus damage.

earthshaker_aftershock.description: Every spell cast causes a mini AoE stun and damage around Earthshaker.
earthshaker_aftershock.coaching_tip: Chain your abilities to extend crowd control with Aftershock procs; every spell becomes a mini stun.

earthshaker_echo_slam.description: Initial shockwave causes each affected unit to generate echo damage to all other nearby units.
earthshaker_echo_slam.coaching_tip: Jump into dense groups including creeps for maximum echoes; Blink into clustered enemies for devastating damage.

elder_titan_echo_stomp.description: Channels a stomp that puts nearby enemies to sleep. Damage from the stomp wakes them.
elder_titan_echo_stomp.coaching_tip: Use to set up Earth Splitter or ally abilities; sleeping enemies take bonus damage from the first hit that wakes them.

elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.description: Sends out a spirit that damages enemies and returns with bonus damage and speed per hero hit.
elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.coaching_tip: Send through enemy heroes for bonus damage on return; the spirit also enables Echo Stomp to hit from two locations.

elder_titan_natural_order.description: Passively removes base armor and magic resistance from nearby enemies.
elder_titan_natural_order.coaching_tip: Natural Order strips armor and magic resistance, making Elder Titan devastating with any damage-dealing ally nearby.

elder_titan_earth_splitter.description: Splits the earth along a line after a delay, slowing and dealing a percentage of max HP as damage.
elder_titan_earth_splitter.coaching_tip: Set up with Echo Stomp sleep to guarantee the hit; the percent-based damage shreds tanky heroes.

ember_spirit_searing_chains.description: Binds nearby random enemies with fire chains, rooting and dealing damage over time.
ember_spirit_searing_chains.coaching_tip: Use Sleight of Fist to get close then Searing Chains for a guaranteed root; effective for locking down a target.

ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.description: Dashes through all enemies in an area attacking each once. Ember is invulnerable during the effect.
ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.coaching_tip: Use to deal damage safely while invulnerable; with damage items each slash hits hard, making it Ember's primary farming and damage tool.

ember_spirit_flame_guard.description: Creates a fire shield that absorbs magic damage and burns nearby enemies.
ember_spirit_flame_guard.coaching_tip: Activate before engaging to absorb magic burst and deal continuous AoE damage; strong for early aggression and fighting.

ember_spirit_fire_remnant.description: Places a fire remnant at the target location. Activate to dash to any remnant, dealing damage along the way.
ember_spirit_fire_remnant.coaching_tip: Always keep one remnant in a safe location as an escape route; use remnants aggressively for gap closing and burst.

enchantress_impetus.description: Enchants attacks with bonus pure damage based on the distance to the target.
enchantress_impetus.coaching_tip: Maximize distance from the target for higher Impetus damage; kite enemies to keep range and exploit the distance scaling.

enchantress_enchant.description: Converts a neutral creep to fight for Enchantress, or slows an enemy hero.
enchantress_enchant.coaching_tip: Convert strong neutral creeps early for powerful lane harass and jungle control; the slow is useful for ganking.

enchantress_natures_attendants.description: Summons healing wisps that follow Enchantress and heal nearby allies over time.
enchantress_natures_attendants.coaching_tip: Activate early in fights for sustained healing over the full duration; the healing adds up significantly over extended engagements.

enchantress_untouchable.description: Passively reduces the attack speed of units that attack Enchantress.
enchantress_untouchable.coaching_tip: Untouchable makes you very tanky against right-click carries; position aggressively knowing attackers will be slowed.

enigma_malefice.description: Repeatedly stuns and damages a target over several seconds.
enigma_malefice.coaching_tip: Use to interrupt channeling abilities and TPs; the repeated stuns prevent enemies from fighting back effectively.

enigma_demonic_conversion.description: Splits a creep into three eidolons that multiply after enough attacks.
enigma_demonic_conversion.coaching_tip: Enigma's core farming tool; efficiently clear jungle camps with eidolons to build an early economy lead.

enigma_midnight_pulse.description: Creates an area dealing percentage-based pure damage over time to enemies within.
enigma_midnight_pulse.coaching_tip: Place Midnight Pulse before Black Hole so enemies take both simultaneously; the percentage damage shreds tanky heroes.

enigma_black_hole.description: Channels to pull all nearby enemies to the center, dealing pure damage. Pierces spell immunity.
enigma_black_hole.coaching_tip: One of the strongest teamfight ultimates in the game; use BKB to protect the channel and aim for multi-hero Black Holes.

faceless_void_time_walk.description: Dashes forward and reverses all damage taken in the last 2 seconds.
faceless_void_time_walk.coaching_tip: Use reactively after taking burst damage to heal it back; the 6s max-level CD makes Void extremely hard to kill.

faceless_void_time_dilation.description: Freezes the cooldowns of all enemy abilities currently on cooldown and slows based on number of frozen abilities.
faceless_void_time_dilation.coaching_tip: Cast after enemies have used their key spells to extend their cooldowns; very strong against ability-dependent heroes.

faceless_void_time_lock.description: Attacks have a chance to deal bonus damage and briefly stun. Pierces spell immunity.
faceless_void_time_lock.coaching_tip: The BKB-piercing bash makes Void lethal inside Chronosphere; build attack speed to proc Time Lock frequently.

faceless_void_chronosphere.description: Creates a sphere where all units except Void are frozen. Affects allies and enemies alike.
faceless_void_chronosphere.coaching_tip: Avoid trapping your own teammates; coordinate with ranged allies who can attack into the Chrono from outside.

grimstroke_dark_artistry.description: Paints a line dealing damage that increases for each enemy hit along the way.
grimstroke_dark_artistry.coaching_tip: Aim through creeps before hitting heroes to maximize damage; the wave clear is also efficient for pushing.

grimstroke_ink_creature.description: Sends a phantom to latch onto a target, silencing and damaging them. If not killed, it re-silences.
grimstroke_ink_creature.coaching_tip: Cast on isolated targets who lack nearby allies to kill the phantom; guaranteed long silence if the phantom is not destroyed.

grimstroke_spirit_walk.description: Buffs an ally with a shield that stuns and damages nearby enemies when it expires.
grimstroke_spirit_walk.coaching_tip: Cast on an initiating ally so the stun detonates in the middle of the enemy team; the movement speed helps them close distance.

grimstroke_soul_chain.description: Binds two enemy heroes together, causing targeted spells cast on one to also affect the other.
grimstroke_soul_chain.coaching_tip: Soulbind makes every targeted disable hit two heroes; combine with ally single-target stuns for double the crowd control.

gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.description: Rapidly fires rockets at the nearest enemy, dealing damage over several seconds.
gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.coaching_tip: Most effective against isolated targets since rockets split among nearby enemies; get close for guaranteed damage.

gyrocopter_homing_missile.description: Launches a missile that tracks and stuns an enemy hero. The missile gains speed over time.
gyrocopter_homing_missile.coaching_tip: Fire from fog or during fights when enemies are distracted; the stun duration scales with distance traveled.

gyrocopter_flak_cannon.description: For a limited number of attacks, Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemies in range.
gyrocopter_flak_cannon.coaching_tip: Activate during teamfights to deal your full attack damage to all visible enemies; excellent for farming stacked camps.

gyrocopter_call_down.description: Calls down two missile strikes on a target area, dealing damage and slowing.
gyrocopter_call_down.coaching_tip: Place on grouped enemies for the double missile hit; the slow helps your team follow up on the initial burst.

hoodwink_acorn_shot.description: Fires an acorn that bounces between enemies dealing physical damage and briefly slowing. Can target trees to plant a new tree.
hoodwink_acorn_shot.coaching_tip: Cast on a tree to plant one and set up Bushwhack; in lane, use for harass and last hitting from range.

hoodwink_bushwhack.description: Throws a trap that binds enemies near trees, stunning and damaging them.
hoodwink_bushwhack.coaching_tip: Combo Acorn Shot on a tree then Bushwhack for a guaranteed stun; enemies must be near trees to be bound.

hoodwink_scurry.description: Passively grants evasion near trees. Actively grants tree-walking and bonus movement speed.
hoodwink_scurry.coaching_tip: Activate to escape through trees when ganked; the passive evasion makes trading in lane near trees favorable.

hoodwink_sharpshooter.description: Charges up and fires a long-range piercing shot dealing heavy magic damage and reducing healing.
hoodwink_sharpshooter.coaching_tip: Charge from fog since the windup reveals your position; combine with ally crowd control for a guaranteed hit.

huskar_inner_fire.description: Knocks back and disarms nearby enemies while dealing magic damage.
huskar_inner_fire.coaching_tip: Use to disarm enemy carries in melee range; the knockback also provides space when being dived.

huskar_burning_spear.description: Attacks apply a stacking DoT at the cost of Huskar's own HP. Can be manually cast to avoid aggro.
huskar_burning_spear.coaching_tip: Stack aggressively in lane for massive sustained damage; manual cast avoids creep aggro while harassing.

huskar_berserkers_blood.description: Passively grants attack speed and magic resistance that scale with missing HP.
huskar_berserkers_blood.coaching_tip: Huskar gets stronger as HP drops, so don't heal to full before fighting; play around the low-HP power spike.

huskar_life_break.description: Leaps at an enemy dealing a percentage of their current HP as damage at the cost of your own HP. Slows the target.
huskar_life_break.coaching_tip: Use to initiate on high-HP targets for maximum percentage damage; the slow keeps enemies from running.

invoker_quas.description: Switches to ice orbs granting HP regen per orb instance. Used in spell invocations.
invoker_quas.coaching_tip: Keep three Quas orbs active while laning for strong HP sustain; high Quas makes Cold Snap and Ice Wall more powerful.

invoker_wex.description: Switches to lightning orbs granting attack speed and movement speed per orb. Used in spell invocations.
invoker_wex.coaching_tip: Wex orbs provide mobility; QW Invoker uses Tornado + EMP for mana drain and crowd control combos.

invoker_exort.description: Switches to fire orbs granting bonus attack damage per orb. Used in spell invocations.
invoker_exort.coaching_tip: Exort orbs give last-hit advantage in lane; QE Invoker uses Sun Strike + Cold Snap + Forge Spirit for kills.

invoker_invoke.description: Combines the three active orbs to invoke a spell. Can hold two invoked spells at once.
invoker_invoke.coaching_tip: Pre-invoke two spells before fights for instant combos; fast spell switching during fights is the key to mastering Invoker.

wisp_tether.description: Tethers to an allied hero, sharing regen and granting movement speed. Stuns enemies Io passes through.
wisp_tether.coaching_tip: Tether to your carry before fights to share healing and regen; the movement speed bonus helps both of you reposition.

wisp_spirits.description: Summons orbiting spirits that damage enemies on contact. Can be moved inward or outward.
wisp_spirits.coaching_tip: Expand spirits for farming and area denial, contract them when close to enemies for burst damage.

wisp_overcharge.description: Grants bonus attack speed and spell amplification to Io and the tethered ally.
wisp_overcharge.coaching_tip: Activate during fights while tethered to buff your carry's damage output; the spell amp applies to both heroes.

wisp_relocate.description: Teleports Io and the tethered ally to any point on the map, returning after a delay.
wisp_relocate.coaching_tip: Relocate for surprise ganks or to defend towers globally; coordinate the timing to secure a kill before returning.

jakiro_dual_breath.description: Breathes fire and ice in a cone, dealing damage and slowing enemy movement and attack speed.
jakiro_dual_breath.coaching_tip: Use in lane to harass and slow enemies; the combined damage and slow make it strong for early fights.

jakiro_ice_path.description: Creates a line of ice that stuns enemies after a brief delay.
jakiro_ice_path.coaching_tip: Place the path where enemies will walk; chain with ally stuns to guarantee the delayed hit.

jakiro_liquid_fire.description: Attacks apply a DoT and attack speed slow to the target and nearby enemies. Works on buildings.
jakiro_liquid_fire.coaching_tip: Use on towers to push since it damages buildings and reduces tower attack speed; excellent for sieging.

jakiro_macropyre.description: Creates a long line of fire dealing massive damage per second to enemies standing in it.
jakiro_macropyre.coaching_tip: Place in chokepoints or on top of stunned enemies to ensure they take full damage; pairs well with Ice Path stun.

juggernaut_blade_fury.description: Spins dealing magic damage to nearby enemies while becoming spell immune. Cannot attack heroes during spin.
juggernaut_blade_fury.coaching_tip: Provides magic immunity for early lane kills with support stuns; note you cannot right-click heroes during spin.

juggernaut_healing_ward.description: Summons a ward that heals nearby allies based on their max HP percentage.
juggernaut_healing_ward.coaching_tip: Extremely valuable for pushing and post-fight recovery; protect the ward since it has only 1 HP.

juggernaut_blade_dance.description: Attacks have a chance to deal critical damage.
juggernaut_blade_dance.coaching_tip: Crits work during Omnislash attacks, amplifying its damage; build attack speed to proc crits more often.

juggernaut_omni_slash.description: Rapidly slashes between enemy units, becoming invulnerable during the effect.
juggernaut_omni_slash.coaching_tip: Use on isolated targets to concentrate all slashes on one hero; avoid using near creep waves that split the bounces.

keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.description: Channels a wave of light that deals increasing damage based on channel time.
keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.coaching_tip: Full channel deals devastating nuke damage; use from fog or behind trees for safe wave clear and teamfight poke.

keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.description: Knocks back enemies and causes them to miss attacks.
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.coaching_tip: Use to push enemies off high ground or away from your carry; the miss chance cripples right-click heroes.

keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.description: Restores mana to a target ally and reduces their ability cooldowns.
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.coaching_tip: Cast on mana-hungry allies to keep them fighting; the cooldown reduction lets carries use key abilities more frequently.

keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp.description: Summons a light that repeatedly stuns nearby enemies in pulses. Destroyed if the wisp is killed.
keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp.coaching_tip: Place in the center of teamfights for repeated AoE stuns; protect the wisp from being destroyed by enemy attacks.

kez_echo_slash.description: Dashes forward slashing enemies in a line, dealing damage and applying a debuff.
kez_echo_slash.coaching_tip: Use for gap closing and burst damage; the dash can also be used to reposition during fights.

kez_grappling_claw.description: Fires a claw that grabs and pulls Kez to the target, dealing damage.
kez_grappling_claw.coaching_tip: Use to initiate or chase fleeing enemies; can also target terrain for mobility and escape.

kez_kazurai_katana.description: Enhances attacks with bonus damage in the current weapon stance.
kez_kazurai_katana.coaching_tip: Synergizes with stance switching; time your empowered attacks for maximum burst between ability rotations.

kez_raptor_dance.description: Powerful ultimate that unleashes a flurry of attacks on nearby enemies.
kez_raptor_dance.coaching_tip: Engage with Echo Slash and Grappling Claw first to get in position before activating Raptor Dance.

kunkka_torrent.description: Calls a waterspout at a location that launches enemies into the air after a delay, stunning and dealing damage.
kunkka_torrent.coaching_tip: Combo with X Marks to guarantee the hit; without setup, predict enemy movement and aim ahead of their path.

kunkka_tidebringer.description: Passively cleaves attacks in a large area in front of Kunkka with bonus damage.
kunkka_tidebringer.coaching_tip: Position to cleave through creeps into enemy heroes for massive harass; one-shots entire waves with enough damage.

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.description: Marks an enemy's position and returns them to it after a delay. Can be activated early.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.coaching_tip: X then Torrent the marked spot for a guaranteed combo; also pull back enemies who TP or blink away.

kunkka_ghostship.description: Summons a ghostly ship that crashes into enemies dealing damage and stunning. Allied heroes in its path get a damage delay buff.
kunkka_ghostship.coaching_tip: The rum buff delays damage for allies, so aim through your teammates first; use for teamfight initiation or counter-initiation.

largo_catchy_lick.description: Lashes out with a musical tongue strike that damages and slows enemies.
largo_catchy_lick.coaching_tip: Use for poke damage and to slow targets for follow-up; low cooldown allows frequent harassment in lane.

largo_frogstomp.description: Leaps into the air and slams down dealing AoE damage and stunning nearby enemies.
largo_frogstomp.coaching_tip: Use as initiation or to interrupt channels; the AoE stun is strong for teamfight setup.

largo_croak_of_genius.description: Provides a passive buff that enhances Largo's abilities and grants benefits to nearby allies.
largo_croak_of_genius.coaching_tip: Stay near allies to share the passive benefits; the enhancement improves your other abilities' effectiveness.

largo_amphibian_rhapsody.description: Performs a powerful musical ultimate that affects a large area with damage and crowd control.
largo_amphibian_rhapsody.coaching_tip: Position centrally for maximum hero coverage; combo with Frogstomp to chain crowd control on the enemy team.

legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.description: Damages enemies in an area dealing bonus damage per unit caught. Grants LC movement speed.
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.coaching_tip: Deals more damage the more enemies and creeps are in the area; use on large creep waves for massive nukes.

legion_commander_press_the_attack.description: Removes debuffs and grants attack speed and health regen to a target ally.
legion_commander_press_the_attack.coaching_tip: Dispels stuns and silences from yourself or allies; cast on your Duel target for attack speed to win the Duel.

legion_commander_moment_of_courage.description: Passively grants a chance to counterattack with bonus lifesteal when attacked.
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.coaching_tip: The lifesteal sustains LC in fights and Duels; higher proc chance at max level makes her very durable.

legion_commander_duel.description: Forces a target enemy to fight LC one-on-one. The winner gains permanent bonus damage.
legion_commander_duel.coaching_tip: Only Duel targets you can kill; each won Duel stacks permanent damage. Use Blink + Blade Mail for pickoffs.

leshrac_split_earth.description: Splits the ground at a target location, stunning and damaging enemies after a short delay.
leshrac_split_earth.coaching_tip: The delay makes it unreliable without setup; combo with ally stuns or use prediction to land it consistently.

leshrac_diabolic_edict.description: Surrounds Leshrac with explosions that deal physical damage to nearby units and buildings.
leshrac_diabolic_edict.coaching_tip: Devastates towers when no creeps are nearby to split damage; activate and walk up to buildings for fast pushes.

leshrac_lightning_storm.description: Strikes a target with lightning that bounces to nearby enemies, slowing each target hit.
leshrac_lightning_storm.coaching_tip: Good wave clear and harass; the bounce and slow are effective for chasing grouped enemies.

leshrac_pulse_nova.description: Toggle that pulses AoE magic damage around Leshrac at the cost of mana per pulse.
leshrac_pulse_nova.coaching_tip: Activate in the middle of teamfights for constant AoE damage; manage your mana pool since it drains quickly.

lich_frost_nova.description: Blasts a target with frost dealing damage and slowing. Damages and slows nearby enemies as well.
lich_frost_nova.coaching_tip: Strong lane harass and slow for kill setups; the AoE damage catches enemies standing near the primary target.

lich_frost_shield.description: Applies a shield to an allied unit that reduces incoming damage and deals damage to nearby attackers.
lich_frost_shield.coaching_tip: Cast on your carry or tower being dived; the damage reduction is significant and the AoE punishes attackers.

lich_sinister_gaze.description: Channels to pull an enemy toward Lich, draining mana.
lich_sinister_gaze.coaching_tip: Use to pull enemies into bad positions or interrupt TPs; the mana drain is effective against mana-dependent heroes.

lich_chain_frost.description: Launches an orb of frost that bounces between enemies dealing heavy damage and slowing with each bounce.
lich_chain_frost.coaching_tip: Most effective when enemies are grouped in pairs or small clusters; avoid using against spread-out teams.

life_stealer_rage.description: Grants spell immunity and bonus attack speed for a duration.
life_stealer_rage.coaching_tip: Activate Rage to ignore disables during fights; time it to dodge key enemy stuns and silences.

life_stealer_open_wounds.description: Slows an enemy and causes all damage dealt to the target to heal the attacker.
life_stealer_open_wounds.coaching_tip: Cast on the target your team is focusing for massive team-wide lifesteal; the slow helps keep them in range.

life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy.description: Passively grants attack speed and slows enemies on attack.
life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy.coaching_tip: The passive slow keeps targets in melee range; combined with Rage, you stick to enemies easily.

life_stealer_infest.description: Hides inside a friendly unit or hero, healing over time. Burst out to deal AoE damage.
life_stealer_infest.coaching_tip: Infest an initiating ally for a surprise bomb entrance; burst out after they jump in for AoE damage and element of surprise.

lina_dragon_slave.description: Sends a wave of fire dealing damage in a line.
lina_dragon_slave.coaching_tip: Primary wave clear and harass spell; aim through creeps to hit heroes behind them.

lina_light_strike_array.description: Calls a column of fire that stuns and damages enemies in a small area after a delay.
lina_light_strike_array.coaching_tip: The delay makes it hard to land raw; combo with ally stuns or predict enemy movement for reliable hits.

lina_fiery_soul.description: Each spell cast grants stacking attack speed and movement speed.
lina_fiery_soul.coaching_tip: Cast spells to build stacks before right-clicking; at full stacks Lina attacks extremely fast.

lina_laguna_blade.description: Fires a bolt of lightning dealing massive single-target magic damage.
lina_laguna_blade.coaching_tip: Use as a finisher on low-HP targets; with Aghanim's it becomes pure damage that pierces BKB.

lion_impale.description: Sends a line of spikes that stuns and damages enemies in a row.
lion_impale.coaching_tip: Line up to hit multiple enemies with the linear stun; primary initiation spell for setting up kills.

lion_voodoo.description: Transforms an enemy into a frog, disabling all abilities and items.
lion_voodoo.coaching_tip: Chain Hex after Earth Spike for extended lockdown; prioritize hexing enemies with Blink Dagger or BKB.

lion_mana_drain.description: Channels to drain mana from a target enemy, restoring Lion's mana.
lion_mana_drain.coaching_tip: Drain mana in lane to starve enemy casters; keeps your own mana full for frequent spell rotations.

lion_finger_of_death.description: Deals massive magic damage to a target. Each kill permanently increases the damage.
lion_finger_of_death.coaching_tip: Secure kills with Finger to stack permanent bonus damage; the 40s max-level CD means you can use it frequently.

lone_druid_spirit_bear.description: Summons a powerful bear companion that can carry items and has its own abilities.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.coaching_tip: The bear is your primary damage dealer and item carrier; keep it close in fights and use it to push towers.

lone_druid_spirit_link.description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, sharing attack speed and lifesteal between them.
lone_druid_spirit_link.coaching_tip: Spirit Link lets both Druid and Bear benefit from each other's items; keep both attacking in fights.

lone_druid_savage_roar.description: Causes nearby enemies to flee toward their fountain briefly.
lone_druid_savage_roar.coaching_tip: Use defensively when enemies dive you, or offensively to break formations; both Druid and Bear can cast it.

lone_druid_true_form.description: Transforms into a melee bear form gaining bonus HP, armor, and attack damage.
lone_druid_true_form.coaching_tip: Transform into True Form for tanky melee fights; switch back to ranged when you need to kite or stay safe.

luna_lucent_beam.description: Fires a beam of moonlight dealing damage and briefly stunning the target.
luna_lucent_beam.coaching_tip: Use to harass and set up kills in lane with the ministun; also levels up Eclipse beam damage.

luna_moon_glaive.description: Attacks bounce to additional nearby enemies, dealing reduced damage with each bounce.
luna_moon_glaive.coaching_tip: Glaive bounces make Luna one of the fastest farmers; use to push waves and clear stacked camps efficiently.

luna_lunar_blessing.description: Passively grants bonus damage and night vision to nearby allied heroes.
luna_lunar_blessing.coaching_tip: The night vision advantage helps your team spot ganks; stay near allies in fights for the damage aura.

luna_eclipse.description: Calls down multiple Lucent Beams on nearby enemies. Limited beams per target.
luna_eclipse.coaching_tip: Most devastating against isolated targets who receive all beams; avoid using in creep waves that absorb beams.

lycan_summon_wolves.description: Summons two wolves that gain abilities as the skill levels, including invisibility and critical strike.
lycan_summon_wolves.coaching_tip: Use wolves for scouting, farming, and harassing; at max level their invisibility makes them excellent scouts.

lycan_howl.description: Grants bonus damage or damage reduction to Lycan and nearby allies and units.
lycan_howl.coaching_tip: Use Howl before team engagements for the global damage buff; it also buffs your summons significantly.

lycan_feral_impulse.description: Passively grants bonus damage and health regen to Lycan and nearby controlled units.
lycan_feral_impulse.coaching_tip: The aura buffs your wolves and any dominated creeps; stay near your summons to maximize their combat power.

lycan_shapeshift.description: Transforms into a wolf gaining max movement speed, critical strike, and bonus night vision.
lycan_shapeshift.coaching_tip: Activate Shapeshift and run at targets; the max movement speed makes you uncatchable. Push or fight aggressively during the duration.

magnataur_shockwave.description: Sends a wave of force in a line dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.
magnataur_shockwave.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and creep wave clear; aim through creeps to also hit enemy heroes behind them.

magnataur_empower.description: Buffs a target with bonus damage and cleave on attacks.
magnataur_empower.coaching_tip: Cast Empower on your team's melee carry for massive cleave damage; it transforms heroes like Juggernaut into farming machines.

magnataur_skewer.description: Charges forward skewering enemies and dragging them along, then slowing them.
magnataur_skewer.coaching_tip: Use after Reverse Polarity to drag stunned enemies into your team; also works as an escape through terrain.

magnataur_reverse_polarity.description: Pulls all nearby enemies to Magnus and stuns them. Pierces spell immunity.
magnataur_reverse_polarity.coaching_tip: Blink into RP is one of the most game-changing initiations; aim for multi-hero RPs to win teamfights instantly.

marci_grapple.description: Grabs an allied or enemy unit and throws them behind Marci, stunning and damaging nearby enemies on landing.
marci_grapple.coaching_tip: Throw an enemy into their teammates for AoE stun; can also throw allies to safety or into better positions.

marci_companion_run.description: Jumps to an ally and then leaps to a target area, stunning enemies where she lands.
marci_companion_run.coaching_tip: Use an ally as a springboard to leap onto enemies; the mobility makes Marci excellent at closing gaps for ganks.

marci_bodyguard.description: Buffs a target ally with lifesteal and damage reduction, providing protection.
marci_bodyguard.coaching_tip: Cast on your carry to give them sustain and survivability in fights; the lifesteal helps them stay topped up.

marci_unleash.description: Enters a fury state granting rapid attacks in combos that finish with a powerful pulse.
marci_unleash.coaching_tip: Activate and focus one target for the rapid combo attacks; the finishing pulse deals AoE damage, so position near enemies.

mars_spear.description: Throws a spear that pushes the first enemy hit, pinning them against trees or walls for a stun.
mars_spear.coaching_tip: Aim to pin enemies against trees, cliffs, or Arena of Blood walls for a guaranteed stun; without terrain it only pushes.

mars_gods_rebuke.description: Smashes enemies in a cone with a massive shield bash, dealing critical damage and knocking them back.
mars_gods_rebuke.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and burst damage; the knockback repositions enemies and works with Arena of Blood.

mars_bulwark.description: Passively reduces damage from the front and sides. Can be activated to redirect nearby attacks to Mars.
mars_bulwark.coaching_tip: Face enemies to reduce incoming damage significantly; activate to protect allies by redirecting attacks to yourself.

mars_arena_of_blood.description: Creates an arena that blocks enemy movement and projectiles from outside. Enemies at the edge take damage.
mars_arena_of_blood.coaching_tip: Trap enemies inside and pin them to the walls with Spear; allies can attack into the arena while enemy projectiles are blocked.

medusa_split_shot.description: Attacks split to hit multiple nearby targets with reduced damage.
medusa_split_shot.coaching_tip: Toggle on for farming and teamfights to hit multiple enemies; toggle off for single-target damage like Roshan.

medusa_mystic_snake.description: Sends a snake that bounces between enemies dealing damage and stealing mana, increasing with each bounce.
medusa_mystic_snake.coaching_tip: Aim at creeps first so the snake gains damage before hitting the enemy hero on later bounces.

medusa_mana_shield.description: Absorbs a portion of incoming damage using mana instead of health.
medusa_mana_shield.coaching_tip: Keep Mana Shield active to effectively double your survivability; manage mana carefully since running out makes you fragile.

medusa_stone_gaze.description: Any enemy facing Medusa is gradually petrified, taking bonus physical damage and becoming stunned if fully turned to stone.
medusa_stone_gaze.coaching_tip: Use when enemies are grouped and facing you; forcing enemies to turn away reduces their damage output significantly.

meepo_earthbind.description: Throws a net that roots enemies in an area, preventing movement.
meepo_earthbind.coaching_tip: Chain roots from multiple Meepos to perma-lock a target; the root doesn't prevent casting, so focus burst damage.

meepo_poof.description: Teleports a Meepo to another Meepo's location, dealing AoE damage at both departure and arrival points.
meepo_poof.coaching_tip: Poof all clones to one location for massive burst damage; Earthbind first then Poof all clones for the kill combo.

meepo_ransack.description: Attacks steal health from enemies, healing the Meepo that lands the hit.
meepo_ransack.coaching_tip: Ransack sustains Meepo clones in fights and while farming; focus all Meepos on one target for combined lifesteal.

meepo_divided_we_stand.description: Creates permanent clones of Meepo that share experience. If any clone dies, all Meepos die.
meepo_divided_we_stand.coaching_tip: Spread clones across the map for maximum farm; always have a safe clone to Poof to when one is in danger.

mirana_starfall.description: Calls down meteors that damage nearby enemies, with a second meteor hitting the closest enemy.
mirana_starfall.coaching_tip: The double hit on the nearest enemy provides strong burst; position close to your target for maximum single-target damage.

mirana_arrow.description: Fires a long-range arrow that stuns and damages the first enemy hit. Stun duration increases with distance.
mirana_arrow.coaching_tip: Max range arrows stun for 5 seconds; shoot from fog and long distance for devastating ganks.

mirana_leap.description: Leaps forward and grants bonus attack and movement speed to nearby allies.
mirana_leap.coaching_tip: Use for chasing, escaping, or dodging abilities; the ally speed boost helps your team engage or disengage.

mirana_invis.description: Turns all allied heroes invisible anywhere on the map after a fade delay.
mirana_invis.coaching_tip: Use for team-wide ganks or escapes; coordinate with your team to initiate together from invisibility.

monkey_king_boundless_strike.description: Extends the staff in a line, stunning and dealing critical damage to all enemies hit.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.coaching_tip: The critical damage scales with your attack damage; use as an initiating stun and burst damage tool.

monkey_king_tree_dance.description: Jumps to a tree, gaining vision and the ability to leap between trees. Can pounce on enemies below.
monkey_king_tree_dance.coaching_tip: Use trees for scouting and positioning before ganks; pounce from trees for a surprise initiation.

monkey_king_jingu_mastery.description: After hitting the same target multiple times, gains massive bonus damage and lifesteal for several attacks.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.coaching_tip: Focus one target to proc the Jingu stacks quickly; the lifesteal and damage bonus make you nearly unkillable.

monkey_king_wukongs_command.description: Creates a ring of soldiers that attack enemies within the area. MK must stay in the ring.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.coaching_tip: Place the ring on top of teamfights; the soldiers deal your attack damage so items scale the ultimate's power.

morphling_waveform.description: Dashes forward as a wave of water, dealing damage and becoming invulnerable during travel.
morphling_waveform.coaching_tip: Use for both initiation and escape; the invulnerability frames can dodge projectiles and damage.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.description: Strikes a target with a blast that deals damage and stuns based on Morphling's primary attribute balance.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.coaching_tip: High AGI gives more damage, high STR gives more stun; shift attributes to get the effect you need for the situation.

morphling_morph_agi.description: Continuously shifts stats from Strength to Agility, increasing damage and armor but reducing HP.
morphling_morph_agi.coaching_tip: Shift to AGI for damage output but watch your HP carefully; shift to STR when low to survive burst damage.

morphling_replicate.description: Morphs into a copy of an enemy hero, gaining their basic abilities.
morphling_replicate.coaching_tip: Copy enemies with powerful basic abilities; you can morph back instantly, making it a versatile combat tool.

muerta_dead_shot.description: Fires a bullet that ricochets off the target, dealing damage and fearing enemies in the ricochet path.
muerta_dead_shot.coaching_tip: Aim the ricochet into trees or toward your team to fear enemies into a bad position; the geometry matters.

muerta_the_calling.description: Summons a circle of revenants that silence and slow enemies who come in contact.
muerta_the_calling.coaching_tip: Place around enemies to prevent them from casting spells; strong for zoning during teamfights.

muerta_gunslinger.description: Passively grants a chance to fire an extra attack at a random nearby enemy.
muerta_gunslinger.coaching_tip: The bonus attacks make Muerta a strong right-clicker; the random shots provide consistent damage in teamfights.

muerta_pierce_the_veil.description: Enters an ethereal state where attacks deal magic damage and cannot be targeted by physical attacks.
muerta_pierce_the_veil.coaching_tip: Activate to deal pure magic damage with attacks while being immune to physical damage; build magic amp to maximize output.

naga_siren_mirror_image.description: Creates illusions of Naga Siren and dispels debuffs.
naga_siren_mirror_image.coaching_tip: Use illusions to farm multiple jungle camps simultaneously; the dispel also removes negative debuffs on cast.

naga_siren_ensnare.description: Roots a target in place, preventing movement but not abilities.
naga_siren_ensnare.coaching_tip: Ensnare goes through BKB, making it a reliable catch tool; use to pin down targets for your illusions to attack.

naga_siren_reel_in.description: Passively causes attacks to reduce armor on the target periodically.
naga_siren_reel_in.coaching_tip: The armor reduction stacks with multiple illusions attacking the same target; focus fire for maximum armor shred.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.description: Puts all nearby enemies to sleep, making them invulnerable. Can be cancelled early.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.coaching_tip: Use to disengage, wait for cooldowns, or set up ally abilities; cancel precisely when your team is ready to burst.

furion_sprout.description: Creates a ring of trees around a target unit, trapping them.
furion_sprout.coaching_tip: Trap enemies without tree-cutting abilities for easy kills; also blocks paths and provides trees for Treant Protector.

furion_teleportation.description: Teleports to any point on the map after a short channel.
furion_teleportation.coaching_tip: Use to join fights globally, push empty lanes, or secure objectives; the global presence pressures the entire map.

furion_force_of_nature.description: Converts trees in an area into treant warriors that fight for Nature's Prophet.
furion_force_of_nature.coaching_tip: Summon treants from Sprout trees or nearby forests to push lanes; they provide vision and can scout dangerous areas.

furion_wrath_of_nature.description: Sends a bouncing bolt of energy that hits enemy heroes globally, dealing increasing damage with each bounce.
furion_wrath_of_nature.coaching_tip: Use to finish off low-HP enemies anywhere on the map; deals more damage to later targets, so it snowballs through enemy heroes.

necrolyte_death_pulse.description: Releases a wave that damages nearby enemies and heals nearby allies.
necrolyte_death_pulse.coaching_tip: Use constantly in fights for sustained damage and healing; the dual effect makes Necrophos strong in extended engagements.

necrolyte_ghost_shroud.description: Enters ghost form gaining movement speed and amplifying healing received, but taking more magic damage.
necrolyte_ghost_shroud.coaching_tip: Use for escape or to amplify Death Pulse healing; avoid using against magic burst since it amplifies incoming magic damage.

necrolyte_heartstopper_aura.description: Passively drains HP from nearby enemies based on their max health.
necrolyte_heartstopper_aura.coaching_tip: The percentage drain is strong against tanky heroes; just being near enemies constantly chips their health.

necrolyte_reapers_scythe.description: Deals massive damage based on how much HP the target is missing. Killed targets have extended respawn.
necrolyte_reapers_scythe.coaching_tip: Use on low-HP targets for guaranteed kills and extended death timers; the added respawn time can win games.

night_stalker_void.description: Deals damage and slows an enemy. During night, also applies a ministun and longer slow.
night_stalker_void.coaching_tip: Void is massively stronger at night; time your aggression for nighttime when the ministun and extended slow activate.

night_stalker_crippling_fear.description: Silences nearby enemies. Duration and effect are enhanced at night.
night_stalker_crippling_fear.coaching_tip: Use during night for a long-duration silence that cripples ability-dependent heroes; run into the enemy team to silence everyone.

night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.description: Passively grants bonus attack speed and movement speed during night time.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.coaching_tip: Night Stalker dominates at night with massive speed advantages; play aggressively during nighttime and farm during day.

night_stalker_darkness.description: Turns day into night and grants Night Stalker flying vision and bonus damage.
night_stalker_darkness.coaching_tip: Activate to force nighttime for all your enhanced abilities; the flying vision lets you see over trees and terrain.

nyx_assassin_impale.description: Sends a line of spikes that stuns and damages enemies.
nyx_assassin_impale.coaching_tip: Use from Vendetta invisibility for a surprise stun; aim to hit multiple enemies in the line.

nyx_assassin_jolt.description: Deals damage to an enemy based on their mana pool, burning a portion of their mana.
nyx_assassin_jolt.coaching_tip: Target high-intelligence heroes with large mana pools for massive damage; effective against Storm Spirit and other casters.

nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.description: Reflects the next instance of damage back to the attacker and stuns them.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.coaching_tip: Time Carapace to reflect predictable abilities like DoTs or AoE spells; the reflected stun can interrupt channels.

nyx_assassin_vendetta.description: Becomes invisible with bonus movement speed. The next attack deals massive bonus damage.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.coaching_tip: Use for scouting and positioning before initiating with the Vendetta strike into Impale combo.

ogre_magi_fireblast.description: Blasts an enemy with fire, dealing damage and stunning.
ogre_magi_fireblast.coaching_tip: Reliable targeted stun for setting up kills; Multicast can make it stun multiple times.

ogre_magi_ignite.description: Hurls a flask of fire that deals DoT and slows the target.
ogre_magi_ignite.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and chasing; the slow keeps enemies in range for your carry to attack.

ogre_magi_bloodlust.description: Buffs a target with bonus attack speed and movement speed.
ogre_magi_bloodlust.coaching_tip: Cast on your carry during fights for a significant DPS boost; also useful on towers and siege creeps for pushing.

ogre_magi_multicast.description: Passively gives Ogre's abilities a chance to cast multiple times.
ogre_magi_multicast.coaching_tip: Multicast makes Ogre's simple spells devastatingly powerful with RNG; at max level the multi-Fireblast is a guaranteed kill.

omniknight_purification.description: Heals an allied unit and deals pure damage to nearby enemies around the healed target.
omniknight_purification.coaching_tip: Cast on melee allies engaged in close combat to heal them and deal AoE damage to nearby enemies simultaneously.

omniknight_martyr.description: Buffs an ally with strong dispel and status resistance, removing debuffs.
omniknight_martyr.coaching_tip: Use to cleanse disables from your carry; the strong dispel removes almost all negative effects.

omniknight_hammer_of_purity.description: Empowers attacks to deal bonus pure damage based on base damage.
omniknight_hammer_of_purity.coaching_tip: The pure damage makes Omni's right-clicks relevant; use to trade effectively in lane against heroes with high armor.

omniknight_guardian_angel.description: Grants nearby allied heroes immunity to physical damage for a duration.
omniknight_guardian_angel.coaching_tip: Use when your team is about to take heavy physical damage; time it to block right-click carries' damage during teamfights.

oracle_fortunes_end.description: Channels then releases a bolt that damages and dispels the target, rooting them.
oracle_fortunes_end.coaching_tip: Use to purge buffs from enemies or debuffs from allies; the root duration scales with channel time.

oracle_fates_edict.description: Disarms a target and grants them 100% magic damage resistance.
oracle_fates_edict.coaching_tip: Use on allies to save them from magic burst, or on enemies to disarm their carry; be careful not to make enemies immune to your team's magic.

oracle_purifying_flames.description: Deals magic damage then heals the target over time. Net effect is healing if the target survives the burst.
oracle_purifying_flames.coaching_tip: Cast on allies to heal them (burst then heal over time); combo with Fortune's End to purge the heal from enemies for pure damage.

oracle_false_promise.description: Delays all damage and healing on a target. At the end, the accumulated result is applied doubled.
oracle_false_promise.coaching_tip: Cast on allies about to die to delay damage; heal them during False Promise since all healing is doubled at the end.

obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb.description: Attacks deal bonus pure damage based on OD's current mana pool.
obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb.coaching_tip: Manual cast in lane to harass without drawing aggro; build mana pool items to scale the pure damage.

obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment.description: Banishes a target into an astral prison, dealing damage when it ends. Can be used on allies.
obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment.coaching_tip: Use on enemies to set up ganks or on allies to save them; the AoE damage on release can hit grouped enemies.
