obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium.description: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of mana on spell cast.
obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium.coaching_tip: Keeps your mana topped up for Arcane Orb usage; the passive sustains your damage output in extended fights.

obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse.description: Deals damage in an area based on the difference between OD's mana and each enemy's mana.
obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse.coaching_tip: Deals more damage to low-mana targets; Astral Imprisonment to drain mana first then Sanity's Eclipse for maximum burst.

pangolier_swashbuckle.description: Dashes forward and rapidly strikes enemies in a line, applying attack effects.
pangolier_swashbuckle.coaching_tip: The slashes apply on-hit effects like Javelin procs; use for damage, farming, and gap closing.

pangolier_shield_crash.description: Jumps forward and slams down, dealing damage and gaining damage reduction per hero hit.
pangolier_shield_crash.coaching_tip: Jump into groups of enemies for maximum damage reduction stacks; combo with Swashbuckle for mobility.

pangolier_lucky_shot.description: Attacks have a chance to disarm and slow enemies.
pangolier_lucky_shot.coaching_tip: Lucky Shot procs on Swashbuckle strikes, potentially disarming multiple enemies; strong against right-click carries.

pangolier_gyroshell.description: Transforms into a ball that rolls forward, stunning and knocking back enemies on impact. Bounces off terrain.
pangolier_gyroshell.coaching_tip: Bounce off walls to change direction and hit multiple enemies; use terrain to your advantage for unpredictable angles.

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.description: Throws a dagger dealing physical damage and slowing. Can trigger attack effects and crits.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.coaching_tip: Excellent last-hitting tool in lane; late game daggers can trigger Coup de Grace crits for huge ranged damage.

phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.description: Blinks to a target gaining bonus attack speed on enemies. Can be used on allies for escape.
phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.coaching_tip: Dagger to slow then Phantom Strike to close the gap; can also blink to allies to escape danger.

phantom_assassin_blur.description: Passively grants evasion. Actively makes PA disappear from the minimap briefly.
phantom_assassin_blur.coaching_tip: Activate Blur to sneak into Roshan or set up ganks without being seen on the minimap; passive evasion counters physical attackers.

phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.description: Attacks have a chance to deal a massive critical strike.
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.coaching_tip: Build raw damage items to maximize crit impact; late-game crits can one-shot most heroes.

phantom_lancer_spirit_lance.description: Throws a lance that damages and slows the target while creating an illusion.
phantom_lancer_spirit_lance.coaching_tip: Use for harass and to spawn an illusion for chasing; the slow helps set up kills in lane.

phantom_lancer_doppelwalk.description: Briefly vanishes and reappears with illusions, dispelling debuffs.
phantom_lancer_doppelwalk.coaching_tip: Use to dodge abilities and dispel debuffs; the brief invulnerability can avoid lethal damage.

phantom_lancer_phantom_edge.description: Passively charges at enemies from a distance when attacking, gaining bonus agility.
phantom_lancer_phantom_edge.coaching_tip: The charge bonus helps close distance; engage from max range to trigger the agility boost for extra damage.

phantom_lancer_juxtapose.description: Attacks and abilities have a chance to create illusions. Illusions can also create illusions.
phantom_lancer_juxtapose.coaching_tip: Build diffusal blade so illusions burn mana; overwhelm enemies with an army of illusions in extended fights.

phoenix_icarus_dive.description: Flies in an arc dealing damage and slowing enemies while consuming own HP.
phoenix_icarus_dive.coaching_tip: Use for both engagement and escape; you can cast Fire Spirits and Sun Ray during the flight.

phoenix_fire_spirits.description: Summons fire spirits that can be launched individually, dealing DoT and reducing attack speed.
phoenix_fire_spirits.coaching_tip: The attack speed reduction cripples enemy carries; launch before Supernova to prevent enemies from destroying the egg.

phoenix_sun_ray.description: Channels a beam dealing percentage-based damage to enemies and healing allies in the ray.
phoenix_sun_ray.coaching_tip: Strong against tanky heroes due to percentage damage; the ally healing makes it useful for sustained fights.

phoenix_supernova.description: Transforms into a burning sun dealing damage. If not destroyed by attacks, Phoenix revives at full HP and stuns.
phoenix_supernova.coaching_tip: Use Fire Spirits' attack speed reduction before Supernova to make the egg harder to destroy; timing is critical.

primal_beast_onslaught.description: Charges forward with increasing speed, damaging and stunning the first enemy hero hit.
primal_beast_onslaught.coaching_tip: Charge from fog for surprise initiations; the longer you charge the more damage and stun it deals.

primal_beast_trample.description: Stomps the ground rapidly dealing AoE damage around Primal Beast while moving.
primal_beast_trample.coaching_tip: Activate after Onslaught to deal continuous damage while on top of enemies; keep moving to maximize coverage.

primal_beast_uproar.description: Gains stacks when hit, which can be activated for bonus damage and damage reduction.
primal_beast_uproar.coaching_tip: Let enemies hit you to build stacks before activating; provides both offensive and defensive bonuses.

primal_beast_pulverize.description: Grabs an enemy and slams them repeatedly, dealing damage and stunning nearby enemies with each slam.
primal_beast_pulverize.coaching_tip: Use on a priority target after initiating; the AoE stuns on each slam can control an entire teamfight.

puck_illusory_orb.description: Launches an orb that damages enemies and allows Puck to teleport to its location.
puck_illusory_orb.coaching_tip: Send the orb ahead for damage then jaunt to it for repositioning; use the travel time to cast other abilities.

puck_waning_rift.description: Blinks to a location and silences nearby enemies while dealing damage.
puck_waning_rift.coaching_tip: Blink into grouped enemies for the AoE silence; combos with Dream Coil to lock down silenced targets.

puck_phase_shift.description: Becomes invulnerable and untargetable for up to several seconds.
puck_phase_shift.coaching_tip: Use to dodge abilities and projectiles with precise timing; shift-queue Illusory Orb jaunt after Phase Shift for escape.

puck_dream_coil.description: Creates a coil that leashes enemies. If they move too far from the coil, they snap and are stunned.
puck_dream_coil.coaching_tip: Cast on grouped enemies to force them to stay in place or take a long stun; follow with silence to prevent them from blinking out.

pudge_meat_hook.description: Throws a hook that grabs the first unit hit, pulling them to Pudge and dealing pure damage.
pudge_meat_hook.coaching_tip: Hook from fog or high ground for best hit rates; immediately activate Rot after hooking an enemy.

pudge_rot.description: Toggleable aura that damages nearby enemies and Pudge himself while slowing enemies.
pudge_rot.coaching_tip: Toggle on after hooking to slow and damage the target; the self-damage builds Flesh Heap stacks.

pudge_flesh_heap.description: Provides passive damage reduction. Nearby enemy hero deaths permanently grant bonus strength.
pudge_flesh_heap.coaching_tip: Stack strength from kills and assists to become increasingly tanky; late-game Pudge with many stacks is extremely hard to kill.

pudge_dismember.description: Channels on a target dealing damage based on strength and healing Pudge. Pierces spell immunity.
pudge_dismember.coaching_tip: Hook + Rot + Dismember is the classic combo; the BKB-piercing channel makes it a reliable lockdown.

pugna_nether_blast.description: Creates an explosion that damages enemies and deals half damage to buildings.
pugna_nether_blast.coaching_tip: One of the best tower-pushing spells in the game; use to pressure objectives and clear waves simultaneously.

pugna_decrepify.description: Makes a target ethereal, amplifying magic damage taken but making them immune to physical attacks.
pugna_decrepify.coaching_tip: Cast on enemies to amplify your magic damage or on allies to save them from physical damage; be careful not to save enemies from your carry.

pugna_nether_ward.description: Places a ward that zaps enemies for mana when they cast spells, dealing damage based on the spell's mana cost.
pugna_nether_ward.coaching_tip: Place before teamfights to punish enemy spellcasters; high mana cost abilities trigger devastating zaps.

pugna_life_drain.description: Channels to drain HP from an enemy, healing Pugna. Can be cast on allies to heal them at Pugna's expense.
pugna_life_drain.coaching_tip: Combo with Decrepify for amplified drain damage; also use to heal allies by draining your own HP to them.

queenofpain_shadow_strike.description: Hurls a dagger that deals initial damage, slows, and applies a DoT to the target.
queenofpain_shadow_strike.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass; the slow and DoT make trading very unfavorable for the enemy laner.

queenofpain_blink.description: Short distance teleportation on a short cooldown.
queenofpain_blink.coaching_tip: Use aggressively to blink in for burst then blink out; the short cooldown allows frequent repositioning.

queenofpain_scream_of_pain.description: Deals AoE magic damage around Queen of Pain.
queenofpain_scream_of_pain.coaching_tip: Blink in then Scream for instant AoE damage; also excellent for farming waves and jungle camps.

queenofpain_sonic_wave.description: Releases a wave of sound in a cone dealing massive pure damage.
queenofpain_sonic_wave.coaching_tip: Aim to hit as many enemies as possible in the cone; the pure damage is not reduced by magic resistance.

razor_plasma_field.description: Releases a ring of plasma that expands then contracts, dealing more damage at maximum range.
razor_plasma_field.coaching_tip: Hit enemies at max ring distance for the highest damage; effective for wave clear and teamfight AoE.

razor_static_link.description: Connects to a target to continuously drain their attack damage, adding it to Razor's own.
razor_static_link.coaching_tip: Link the enemy carry to steal their damage; maintain the link by chasing them and avoiding breaking distance.

razor_storm_surge.description: Passively grants movement speed. Attacks from enemies can trigger a lightning strike.
razor_storm_surge.coaching_tip: The passive move speed makes Razor hard to kite; combined with Static Link you can chase anyone down.

razor_eye_of_the_storm.description: Calls a storm that strikes the lowest-HP enemy nearby with lightning, reducing armor.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.coaching_tip: Activate when pushing towers since it hits buildings; in teamfights it shreds armor on focused targets.

riki_smoke_screen.description: Creates a cloud that silences enemies and causes them to miss attacks while inside.
riki_smoke_screen.coaching_tip: Drop Smoke Screen on enemy carries to silence and blind them; they must leave the cloud to attack effectively.

riki_blink_strike.description: Teleports behind the target dealing bonus damage from behind.
riki_blink_strike.coaching_tip: Use to gap close and get behind targets for Backstab damage; also useful for escaping by targeting allied creeps.

riki_tricks_of_the_trade.description: Becomes hidden and attacks all enemies in an area from behind for several seconds.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.coaching_tip: Use when surrounded for invulnerable AoE backstab damage; also dodges incoming abilities during the effect.

riki_backstab.description: Passively grants permanent invisibility with a fade delay. Attacks from behind deal bonus damage based on agility.
riki_backstab.coaching_tip: Always position behind your target for maximum backstab damage; build agility items to scale the bonus damage.

ringmaster_tame_the_beasts.description: Cracks a whip to damage and control enemies in a line.
ringmaster_tame_the_beasts.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and to control enemy positioning; the range lets you stay safe while dealing damage.

ringmaster_the_box.description: Creates a box that can trap or protect units inside.
ringmaster_the_box.coaching_tip: Use defensively to save allies or offensively to trap enemies; versatile utility for various fight situations.

ringmaster_impalement.description: Throws knives that damage and pin enemies in place.
ringmaster_impalement.coaching_tip: Aim for grouped enemies to pin multiple targets; the lockdown sets up follow-up damage from your team.

ringmaster_wheel.description: Spins a wheel that applies random powerful effects to enemies in the area.
ringmaster_wheel.coaching_tip: Position the wheel to cover the teamfight area; the random effects can swing fights significantly.

rubick_telekinesis.description: Lifts an enemy into the air and throws them to a target location, stunning nearby enemies on landing.
rubick_telekinesis.coaching_tip: Lift then throw enemies into your team or onto other enemies for the AoE stun; great for repositioning targets.

rubick_fade_bolt.description: Launches a bouncing bolt that damages and reduces attack damage of each enemy hit.
rubick_fade_bolt.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and wave clear; the attack damage reduction helps win trades in lane.

rubick_arcane_supremacy.description: Passively increases cast range and spell amplification.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.coaching_tip: The extra cast range lets you steal spells from safer distances; spell amp makes stolen abilities even stronger.

rubick_spell_steal.description: Steals the last spell cast by the target enemy hero for Rubick's use.
rubick_spell_steal.coaching_tip: Watch for high-value ultimates like Ravage or Black Hole to steal; Arcane Supremacy makes stolen spells stronger than originals.

sandking_burrowstrike.description: Burrows forward in a line, stunning and damaging all enemies along the path.
sandking_burrowstrike.coaching_tip: Use as initiation or escape; the stun line can catch multiple enemies for follow-up Epicenter damage.

sandking_sand_storm.description: Channels a sandstorm around Sand King, dealing AoE damage and making him invisible.
sandking_sand_storm.coaching_tip: Use to disappear during fights or farm jungle camps; enemies need detection to reveal you inside the storm.

sandking_caustic_finale.description: Attacks apply a debuff that explodes on death, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
sandking_caustic_finale.coaching_tip: Hit creeps to make them explode on death for splash damage; excellent for lane harass and pushing.

sandking_epicenter.description: Channels then releases powerful pulses that damage and slow all nearby enemies.
sandking_epicenter.coaching_tip: Channel from fog then Blink or Burrowstrike into enemies for a surprise Epicenter; the channeling time requires safe setup.

shadow_demon_disruption.description: Banishes a target and creates two illusions of them that attack the target.
shadow_demon_disruption.coaching_tip: Use on enemy carries to create illusions that deal their damage back; also saves allies by banishing them from danger.

shadow_demon_disseminate.description: Causes a portion of damage dealt to the target to be shared with nearby enemies.
shadow_demon_disseminate.coaching_tip: Cast on a target your team is focusing to spread damage to nearby enemies; amplifies total team damage output.

shadow_demon_shadow_poison.description: Casts a shadow poison that stacks on enemies. Releasing the stacks deals exponentially increasing damage.
shadow_demon_shadow_poison.coaching_tip: Stack poison on enemies before releasing for exponential damage growth; 4-5 stacks deals massive burst.

shadow_demon_demonic_purge.description: Purges an enemy, slowing them continuously and dealing damage over time.
shadow_demon_demonic_purge.coaching_tip: Use to remove buffs from enemies and apply a strong slow; effective for kiting and chasing targets.

nevermore_shadowraze3.description: Blasts enemies at a specific range with shadow energy. Three razes at different distances, each stacking damage.
nevermore_shadowraze3.coaching_tip: Learn the three raze distances to land combos; triple raze on one target deals enormous damage with stacking bonuses.

nevermore_necromastery.description: Gains bonus damage for each unit killed, up to a cap. Loses half the souls on death.
nevermore_necromastery.coaching_tip: Prioritize last-hitting to build soul stacks; dying loses half your souls, so position carefully to avoid deaths.

nevermore_dark_lord.description: Passively reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
nevermore_dark_lord.coaching_tip: The armor reduction makes SF's physical damage much stronger; position near enemies to ensure the aura applies.

nevermore_requiem.description: Releases all collected souls as lines of damage, dealing more damage based on souls and proximity.
nevermore_requiem.coaching_tip: Most devastating at point-blank range with full souls; Blink into Requiem or use Eul's to set up the delayed cast.

shadow_shaman_ether_shock.description: Strikes a target with lightning that chains to nearby enemies.
shadow_shaman_ether_shock.coaching_tip: Efficient wave clear and harass; the chain damage hits multiple enemies making it strong in lane.

shadow_shaman_voodoo.description: Transforms an enemy into a critter, disabling all abilities and items.
shadow_shaman_voodoo.coaching_tip: One of the longest single-target disables at max level; prioritize hexing high-threat targets in fights.

shadow_shaman_shackles.description: Channels to hold and damage an enemy. SS is also immobilized during the channel.
shadow_shaman_shackles.coaching_tip: Chain Hex into Shackles for extremely long lockdown; position safely since you are immobilized too.

shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.description: Summons a ring of serpent wards that attack enemies and buildings in range.
shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.coaching_tip: Place next to towers for rapid pushing; trap enemies inside the ward circle for guaranteed damage.

silencer_curse_of_the_silent.description: Curses enemies in an area, dealing damage over time that increases when they cast spells.
silencer_curse_of_the_silent.coaching_tip: Cast on enemies who want to spam abilities; they take more damage for each spell they cast during the curse.

silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.description: Attacks deal bonus pure damage based on Silencer's intelligence.
silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.coaching_tip: Manual cast to harass without aggro in lane; the pure damage scales with stolen intelligence from kills.

silencer_last_word.description: Places a debuff that silences and damages the target after they cast a spell or after a delay.
silencer_last_word.coaching_tip: Forces enemies to choose between casting and being silenced, or waiting and being silenced anyway; strong against combo heroes.

silencer_global_silence.description: Silences all enemy heroes on the map for several seconds.
silencer_global_silence.coaching_tip: Use at the start of teamfights to prevent enemy initiations; the global range can also stop TPs across the map.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.description: Fires a bolt that deals damage scaling with Skywrath's intelligence.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.coaching_tip: Low cooldown allows constant harass; the intelligence scaling makes it deal significant damage late game.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.description: Fires a shot at the nearest visible enemy hero, dealing damage and slowing.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.coaching_tip: Use to slow fleeing enemies; it auto-targets the closest hero so position carefully to hit the right target.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.description: Silences a target and amplifies magic damage they take.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.coaching_tip: Cast before your damage combo to amplify all magic damage; the silence prevents them from using escape abilities.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.description: Rains mystic energy on an area dealing massive magic damage split among enemies inside.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.coaching_tip: Use on isolated targets so damage is not split; combo with Ancient Seal and allied stuns for guaranteed kills.

slardar_sprint.description: Grants bonus movement speed with extra speed in water areas.
slardar_sprint.coaching_tip: Use to chase enemies or rotate between lanes quickly; the river speed bonus is massive for securing rune fights.

slardar_slithereen_crush.description: Slams the ground stunning and damaging nearby enemies.
slardar_slithereen_crush.coaching_tip: Blink into Crush for reliable AoE initiation; follow up with Corrosive Haze on the priority target.

slardar_bash.description: Attacks periodically deal bonus physical damage and stun the target.
slardar_bash.coaching_tip: The guaranteed bash on a timer makes Slardar's right-clicks very threatening; time attacks to land the bash stun.

slardar_amplify_damage.description: Reduces target's armor massively and provides true sight of them.
slardar_amplify_damage.coaching_tip: Cast on enemy carries to strip their armor; also reveals invisible heroes, making it a counter to stealth.

slark_dark_pact.description: Purges debuffs after a delay and deals AoE damage around Slark, also damaging himself.
slark_dark_pact.coaching_tip: Time Dark Pact to purge incoming stuns and roots; the delay means you must predict when disables will hit.

slark_pounce.description: Leaps forward and tethers the first enemy hero hit, preventing them from moving away.
slark_pounce.coaching_tip: Use to close distance and leash targets in place; combine with Dark Pact to purge any disables during the engage.

slark_essence_shift.description: Each attack steals stats from the enemy, gaining agility while they lose attributes.
slark_essence_shift.coaching_tip: Extended fights favor Slark as stats stack; focus one target to drain them of all attributes quickly.

slark_shadow_dance.description: Becomes invisible and untargetable with bonus movement speed and health regeneration.
slark_shadow_dance.coaching_tip: Use to reset during fights and regenerate health; you cannot be revealed by detection during Shadow Dance.

snapfire_scatterblast.description: Fires a shotgun blast that deals damage and slows, with bonus damage at close range.
snapfire_scatterblast.coaching_tip: Get close for the point-blank bonus damage; effective for lane harass and clearing creep waves.

snapfire_firesnap_cookie.description: Feeds a cookie to an ally or herself, causing them to jump forward and stun enemies on landing.
snapfire_firesnap_cookie.coaching_tip: Cast on initiating allies for a launch-stun combo; can also be used on yourself for an escape jump.

snapfire_lil_shredder.description: Fires rapid attacks at a target that reduce armor and deal fixed damage.
snapfire_lil_shredder.coaching_tip: Use on towers for fast pushing; the armor reduction stacks make it effective for focus-firing targets.

snapfire_mortimer_kisses.description: Spits globs of fire at target areas dealing AoE damage and slowing in a large range.
snapfire_mortimer_kisses.coaching_tip: Fire from a safe distance to zone enemies and deal sustained AoE damage; each glob leaves a burning area.

sniper_shrapnel.description: Fires shrapnel at a target area dealing damage and slowing enemies while providing vision. Uses charges.
sniper_shrapnel.coaching_tip: Provides vision for scouting Roshan and high ground; save at least one charge for emergencies.

sniper_headshot.description: Attacks have a chance to deal bonus damage and briefly slow the target.
sniper_headshot.coaching_tip: The proc rate is high with fast attacks; the mini-slow makes it hard for enemies to close the distance.

sniper_take_aim.description: Passively increases attack range. Can be activated for extra range and terrain ignoring.
sniper_take_aim.coaching_tip: The massive range lets Sniper attack safely from behind the team; activate to attack over cliffs and trees.

sniper_assassinate.description: Fires a high-damage shot at long range that stuns on impact.
sniper_assassinate.coaching_tip: Use to finish low-HP fleeing enemies; the 10s max-level CD means use it liberally.

spectre_spectral_dagger.description: Throws a dagger that damages enemies and creates a shadow path, granting Spectre phased movement and bonus speed.
spectre_spectral_dagger.coaching_tip: Use the shadow path to chase through terrain and trees; the pathing bonus lets Spectre stick to targets.

spectre_desolate.description: Passively deals bonus pure damage to enemies who are alone, without allied units nearby.
spectre_desolate.coaching_tip: Target isolated heroes for the Desolate bonus; Haunt illusions also proc Desolate on lonely targets.

spectre_dispersion.description: Passively reflects a portion of damage taken to nearby enemies.
spectre_dispersion.coaching_tip: Dispersion makes Spectre tankier the more damage she takes; stand in the middle of fights to reflect damage to all enemies.

spectre_haunt.description: Creates an illusion attacking each enemy hero globally. Spectre can swap with any illusion.
spectre_haunt.coaching_tip: Use Haunt to join fights globally and kill fleeing enemies; Reality swap to the most vulnerable target for the kill.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.description: Charges toward a target enemy anywhere on the map, gaining speed and bashing them on arrival.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.coaching_tip: Charge from across the map for surprise ganks; allied heroes can see the charge path for coordinated plays.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.description: Gains bonus movement speed and status resistance for a duration.
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.coaching_tip: Activate during Charge to become harder to stop; the status resistance reduces stun durations significantly.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.description: Attacks have a chance to bash, dealing bonus damage based on movement speed and pushing the target.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.coaching_tip: Build movement speed items to increase bash damage; the proc chance makes Spirit Breaker's right-clicks threatening.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.description: Teleports to a target and strikes them with a Greater Bash. Pierces spell immunity.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.coaching_tip: Use after Charge for a guaranteed follow-up stun; the BKB pierce makes it reliable against magic-immune targets.

storm_spirit_static_remnant.description: Creates a static remnant that explodes when an enemy gets close, dealing AoE damage.
storm_spirit_static_remnant.coaching_tip: Place remnants on top of yourself during fights for instant detonation; use for wave clear and jungle farming.

storm_spirit_electric_vortex.description: Pulls an enemy toward Storm Spirit over a short duration.
storm_spirit_electric_vortex.coaching_tip: Use after zipping in with Ball Lightning to pull targets into your team; the disable duration is significant.

storm_spirit_overload.description: Every spell cast charges the next attack with bonus damage and an AoE slow.
storm_spirit_overload.coaching_tip: Weave auto-attacks between spell casts to proc Overload on every hit; the slow helps you stick to targets.

storm_spirit_ball_lightning.description: Transforms into lightning, moving to a target point and damaging enemies along the way. Costs mana based on distance.
storm_spirit_ball_lightning.coaching_tip: Manage mana carefully since long zips drain mana fast; short zips are more mana efficient for chasing and dodging.

sven_storm_bolt.description: Hurls a hammer that stuns and damages enemies in an AoE around the target.
sven_storm_bolt.coaching_tip: Reliable AoE stun for initiation; aim at grouped enemies to stun multiple targets.

sven_great_cleave.description: Passively cleaves attack damage in a large area in front of Sven.
sven_great_cleave.coaching_tip: The massive cleave makes Sven farm incredibly fast; in fights, position to cleave through grouped enemies.

sven_warcry.description: Grants bonus armor and movement speed to Sven and nearby allies.
sven_warcry.coaching_tip: Use before engaging for the armor and speed boost; helps your entire team survive and chase.

sven_gods_strength.description: Greatly multiplies Sven's base damage for a duration.
sven_gods_strength.coaching_tip: Activate before fights for massive damage; the multiplied damage cleaves with Great Cleave for devastating AoE.

techies_sticky_bomb.description: Throws a bomb that sticks to the first enemy hero it contacts, slowing then dealing damage.
techies_sticky_bomb.coaching_tip: Use for lane harass and zoning; the slow sets up follow-up abilities from your team.

techies_reactive_tazer.description: Grants Techies a shield that disarms attackers who hit Techies and provides movement speed.
techies_reactive_tazer.coaching_tip: Activate when enemies dive you to disarm them; the movement speed helps reposition to safety.

techies_suicide.description: Techies launches into the air toward a target area, dealing damage and silencing enemies on landing at the cost of HP.
techies_suicide.coaching_tip: Use for aggressive initiations with the AoE silence; the self-damage is significant so ensure the trade is worth it.

techies_land_mines.description: Plants an invisible mine that detonates when enemies walk near, dealing AoE damage.
techies_land_mines.coaching_tip: Stack mines in common paths and rune spots; use for area denial and defending objectives.

templar_assassin_refraction.description: Grants instances of damage block and bonus attack damage. Each instance absorbs one damage instance.
templar_assassin_refraction.coaching_tip: Activate before trading in lane for both damage and protection; time it to block key incoming damage instances.

templar_assassin_meld.description: Becomes invisible while stationary. The next attack deals bonus damage and reduces armor.
templar_assassin_meld.coaching_tip: Use for burst damage by Meld-striking then immediately attacking; the armor reduction amplifies follow-up hits.

templar_assassin_psi_blades.description: Attacks spill through targets in a line, dealing full damage to units behind.
templar_assassin_psi_blades.coaching_tip: Position to spill attacks through creeps onto enemy heroes for safe harass; the spill range extends your effective reach.

templar_assassin_psionic_trap.description: Places invisible traps that slow enemies when detonated. Slow increases with trap age.
templar_assassin_psionic_trap.coaching_tip: Scatter traps across the map for vision and slow; older traps slow more, so place them early on key paths.

terrorblade_reflection.description: Creates invulnerable illusions of enemy heroes that attack their source, slowing them.
terrorblade_reflection.coaching_tip: Cast on enemy carries to turn their damage against them; the slow helps keep them in range.

terrorblade_conjure_image.description: Creates a strong illusion of Terrorblade.
terrorblade_conjure_image.coaching_tip: Use illusions to farm multiple camps and push lanes; they deal significant damage and are key to TB's farming speed.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.description: Transforms into a ranged demon gaining bonus damage and attack range but losing movement speed.
terrorblade_metamorphosis.coaching_tip: Push towers and fight during Meta duration; the ranged form deals massive damage. Play around its long cooldown.

terrorblade_sunder.description: Swaps HP percentages with a target. Minimum HP threshold prevents instant kills.
terrorblade_sunder.coaching_tip: Sunder enemies when you are low and they are high for a massive HP swing; also works on allies to save them.

tidehunter_gush.description: Blasts a target with water dealing damage and reducing armor and movement speed.
tidehunter_gush.coaching_tip: The armor reduction pairs well with physical damage teammates; Aghanim's upgrades it to a ground-targeted AoE.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.description: Passively blocks damage per hit. After taking threshold damage, automatically dispels all debuffs.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.coaching_tip: Makes Tide extremely hard to lock down; the auto-dispel triggers when focused, freeing you to cast Ravage.

tidehunter_anchor_smash.description: Smashes nearby enemies dealing damage and massively reducing their attack damage.
tidehunter_anchor_smash.coaching_tip: The attack damage reduction at max level cripples enemy carries; spam it in fights on short cooldown.

tidehunter_ravage.description: Unleashes tentacles in a huge area, stunning and damaging all enemies hit.
tidehunter_ravage.coaching_tip: One of the largest AoE stuns in the game; Blink into Ravage for multi-hero stuns. 150s CD so do not waste it.

shredder_whirling_death.description: Spins and deals AoE damage, cutting down trees. Enemies hit near trees take bonus pure damage and lose primary attribute.
shredder_whirling_death.coaching_tip: Fight near trees for the bonus pure damage and stat reduction; the attribute loss cripples enemy carries temporarily.

shredder_timber_chain.description: Fires a chain that latches to a tree, pulling Timbersaw to it and dealing damage along the path.
shredder_timber_chain.coaching_tip: Use for high mobility around trees; chain to trees aggressively for damage or defensively for escape.

shredder_reactive_armor.description: Passively gains stacks of armor and HP regen when attacked, making Timbersaw tankier the more hits taken.
shredder_reactive_armor.coaching_tip: Let enemies attack you to build stacks; at max stacks Timbersaw is extremely durable in lane.

shredder_chakram.description: Throws a spinning blade that deals damage in its path and where it stays, slowing enemies.
shredder_chakram.coaching_tip: Place Chakram on top of fights for sustained AoE damage and slow; return it through enemies for additional damage.

tinker_laser.description: Fires a laser dealing pure damage and blinding the target, causing them to miss attacks.
tinker_laser.coaching_tip: The miss debuff counters right-click carries; use Rearm to spam Laser for continuous blinds.

tinker_march_of_the_machines.description: Deploys a wave of robots that march forward, dealing magic damage to enemies they pass through.
tinker_march_of_the_machines.coaching_tip: Stack March casts with Rearm for massive area denial; use to defend high ground or farm dangerous areas safely.

tinker_defense_matrix.description: Shields an ally with a barrier that absorbs damage and grants status resistance.
tinker_defense_matrix.coaching_tip: Cast on allies who are being focused to absorb burst damage; Rearm lets you recast it repeatedly.

tinker_rearm.description: Channels to reset the cooldowns of most abilities and items.
tinker_rearm.coaching_tip: Rearm is what makes Tinker powerful; manage mana carefully and chain ability resets for sustained teamfight pressure.

tiny_avalanche.description: Drops rocks in an area dealing damage and stunning enemies.
tiny_avalanche.coaching_tip: Combo with Toss for double damage; Avalanche into Toss is the standard burst combo for early kills.

tiny_toss.description: Grabs the nearest unit and throws it at a target location, dealing damage in the area.
tiny_toss.coaching_tip: Toss enemies into your team or onto cliffs; can also throw allies for repositioning plays.

tiny_tree_grab.description: Grabs a tree that increases attack range, adds cleave, and deals bonus building damage.
tiny_tree_grab.coaching_tip: Always have a tree equipped for the cleave and extra range; the building damage bonus makes Tiny an excellent pusher.

tiny_grow.description: Increases Tiny's size, granting bonus damage, armor, and building damage while reducing attack speed.
tiny_grow.coaching_tip: The massive damage multiplier works with Tree Grab cleave; build attack speed items to compensate for the AS penalty.

treant_natures_grasp.description: Creates a line of vines that damage and root enemies who touch them.
treant_natures_grasp.coaching_tip: Place in chokepoints to zone enemies; the vines linger and provide area control in teamfights.

treant_leech_seed.description: Plants a seed on a target that slows them and heals nearby allies over time.
treant_leech_seed.coaching_tip: Cast on enemies near your allies for sustained healing and slow; strong for trading in lane.

treant_living_armor.description: Globally protects a target ally or building with bonus HP regen and damage block instances.
treant_living_armor.coaching_tip: Cast globally to save allies or protect towers under siege; monitor the map for allies taking damage.

treant_overgrowth.description: Roots all nearby enemies, preventing movement and dealing damage over time.
treant_overgrowth.coaching_tip: Blink into Overgrowth for an AoE root initiation; the root goes through BKB making it reliable crowd control.

troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.description: Toggles between ranged and melee form. Melee form gains bonus armor, movement speed, and bash.
troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.coaching_tip: Switch to melee for the bash and durability when fighting, ranged for safe harass and farming; toggle dynamically.

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.description: Throws axes that slow enemies hit. Different from the melee version.
troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.coaching_tip: Use ranged axes to slow fleeing enemies; switch to melee axes for the blind effect in close combat.

troll_warlord_fervor.description: Each consecutive attack on the same target grants stacking attack speed.
troll_warlord_fervor.coaching_tip: Focus one target to build attack speed stacks quickly; switching targets resets your stacks.

troll_warlord_battle_trance.description: Enters a trance granting max attack speed, lifesteal, and movement speed, but forced to attack the nearest target.
troll_warlord_battle_trance.coaching_tip: Use when locked onto a priority target since you cannot switch targets; the lifesteal makes you nearly unkillable during the trance.

tusk_ice_shards.description: Launches a shard projectile that creates an impassable wall of ice, trapping enemies.
tusk_ice_shards.coaching_tip: Aim to trap enemies against terrain with the ice wall; the wall blocks paths for 7 seconds.

tusk_snowball.description: Rolls toward a target gathering allies inside, stunning enemies on impact.
tusk_snowball.coaching_tip: Gather allies in Snowball for a group initiation stun; you choose when to launch, so wait for teammates.

tusk_walrus_kick.description: Kicks an enemy away, dealing damage and slowing them.
tusk_walrus_kick.coaching_tip: Use to kick enemies into your team or away from allies; the reposition can be fight-winning.

tusk_walrus_punch.description: Empowers the next attack with a critical strike that launches the target into the air and slows them.
tusk_walrus_punch.coaching_tip: The massive crit deals huge burst on squishy targets; combo with Snowball stun for guaranteed landing.

abyssal_underlord_firestorm.description: Calls down waves of fire dealing damage and a percentage of max HP as burn damage.
abyssal_underlord_firestorm.coaching_tip: Place on creep waves and teamfight areas for sustained AoE damage; the max HP burn is effective against tanky heroes.

abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.description: Creates a pit that periodically roots enemies standing in it.
abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.coaching_tip: Place in chokepoints to repeatedly root enemies who try to walk through; combos with Firestorm for area control.

abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.description: Passively reduces nearby enemy attack damage. Underlord gains temporary bonus damage when nearby enemies die.
abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.coaching_tip: The aura cripples enemy right-click damage; the bonus damage from dying units makes Underlord stronger in prolonged fights.

abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.description: Opens a portal between two locations that allied heroes can use to teleport.
abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.coaching_tip: Use to globally reposition your team for split-push or to join fights; the portal allows strategic map movement.

undying_decay.description: Steals strength from nearby enemies, dealing damage and gaining max HP.
undying_decay.coaching_tip: Spam in lane to steal enemy strength; after several casts you become very tanky while enemies become fragile.

undying_soul_rip.description: Damages an enemy or heals an ally based on the number of nearby units.
undying_soul_rip.coaching_tip: Most effective in large creep waves or teamfights with many units nearby; versatile as both damage and heal.

undying_tombstone.description: Summons a tombstone that spawns zombies to attack nearby enemies, slowing them.
undying_tombstone.coaching_tip: Place at the start of teamfights; the zombies overwhelm enemies and the slow is crippling. Protect the tombstone.

undying_flesh_golem.description: Transforms into a flesh golem, amplifying damage enemies take and slowing nearby enemies.
undying_flesh_golem.coaching_tip: Activate and walk into the enemy team; the damage amp aura makes your team's burst significantly stronger.

ursa_earthshock.description: Leaps forward and slams the ground, slowing all enemies in the area.
ursa_earthshock.coaching_tip: Use for gap closing and applying the AoE slow; combo with Overpower for immediate burst.

ursa_overpower.description: Grants a set number of attacks with maximum attack speed.
ursa_overpower.coaching_tip: Activate before engaging to dump all empowered attacks instantly; each hit stacks Fury Swipes for escalating damage.

ursa_fury_swipes.description: Each consecutive attack on the same target deals stacking bonus damage.
ursa_fury_swipes.coaching_tip: Focus one target to build stacks rapidly; Ursa shreds Roshan with Fury Swipes making early Rosh possible.

ursa_enrage.description: Multiplies Fury Swipes damage and provides damage reduction with a strong dispel.
ursa_enrage.coaching_tip: Activate to dispel disables and become very tanky; the Fury Swipes multiplier makes attacks devastating.

vengefulspirit_magic_missile.description: Fires a bolt that stuns and damages a target enemy.
vengefulspirit_magic_missile.coaching_tip: Reliable targeted stun for ganks and initiation; low cooldown allows frequent use in fights.

vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.description: Sends a wave that reduces enemy armor and provides vision along its path.
vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.coaching_tip: Use to scout and reduce armor before engaging; the vision reveals enemies in fog and Roshan pit.

vengefulspirit_command_aura.description: Passively grants bonus damage to nearby allies. On death, spawns an illusion of VS.
vengefulspirit_command_aura.coaching_tip: Stay near your carry for the damage aura; the death illusion provides continued presence after dying.

vengefulspirit_nether_swap.description: Swaps positions with a target hero, ally or enemy.
vengefulspirit_nether_swap.coaching_tip: Swap enemy cores into your team for kills, or swap allies out of danger for saves; extremely versatile positioning tool.

venomancer_venomous_gale.description: Launches a plague gale that strikes all enemies in a line, slowing and dealing damage over time.
venomancer_venomous_gale.coaching_tip: Hit multiple enemies in lane for sustained slow and damage; the long duration DoT is strong for chasing.

venomancer_poison_sting.description: Passively applies a slow and damage over time to enemies on attack.
venomancer_poison_sting.coaching_tip: Auto-attacks constantly apply poison, making Venomancer excellent at harassment; plague wards also apply Poison Sting.

venomancer_plague_ward.description: Summons a stationary ward that attacks enemies with poisonous attacks.
venomancer_plague_ward.coaching_tip: Place wards to push lanes, block camps, and provide vision; they apply Poison Sting on their attacks.

venomancer_noxious_plague.description: Infects an enemy hero with a deadly plague that deals damage and spreads to nearby enemies on death.
venomancer_noxious_plague.coaching_tip: Cast on enemies grouped together since the plague spreads on death; the damage scales with enemy proximity.

viper_poison_attack.description: Autocast that adds poison to attacks dealing magic DoT and slowing. Stacks.
viper_poison_attack.coaching_tip: Manually cast in lane to harass without drawing aggro; stacking on one target amplifies the slow and damage.

viper_nethertoxin.description: Creates a pool of toxin that deals increasing damage and disables passives of enemies standing in it.
viper_nethertoxin.coaching_tip: Counters passive-reliant heroes like Bristleback and PA; place under controlled enemies for guaranteed effect.

viper_corrosive_skin.description: Passively grants magic resistance and applies a slow and DoT to attackers.
viper_corrosive_skin.coaching_tip: Makes Viper very durable against both magic and physical; enemies who attack you are slowed and damaged.

viper_viper_strike.description: Fires a powerful poison at a target dealing heavy DoT and massive slow. Pierces spell immunity.
viper_viper_strike.coaching_tip: The BKB-piercing slow pins down enemy carries; 10s max-level CD means use it frequently.

visage_grave_chill.description: Slows an enemy's attack and movement speed while boosting Visage's own.
visage_grave_chill.coaching_tip: Cast on enemy carries to steal their speed; the attack speed steal makes you attack faster while they attack slower.

visage_soul_assumption.description: Fires a bolt that deals damage based on the number of damage instances nearby. Charges from ambient damage.
visage_soul_assumption.coaching_tip: Fire when fully charged during teamfights for heavy burst; nearby hero damage rapidly charges the bolt.

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.description: Provides damage reduction layers that regenerate over time, reducing incoming damage instances.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.coaching_tip: The damage reduction layers make Visage tanky against burst; avoid sustained DoT which strips layers quickly.

visage_summon_familiars.description: Summons stone gargoyle familiars that have a powerful stun and high damage.
visage_summon_familiars.coaching_tip: Use familiars for scouting, stunning, and damage; Stone Form stun is AoE and can be chained between familiars.

void_spirit_aether_remnant.description: Sends a remnant to a location that watches and pulls the first enemy it detects, dealing damage.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.coaching_tip: Place in paths enemies will walk through for guaranteed pulls; the remnant provides vision and area denial.

void_spirit_dissimilate.description: Briefly vanishes into the void, then reappears at a chosen location dealing damage.
void_spirit_dissimilate.coaching_tip: Use to dodge abilities and reposition; choose your exit point to deal damage or escape safely.

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.description: Emits a pulse dealing damage and gaining a physical damage shield based on enemies hit.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.coaching_tip: Hit as many enemies as possible for a larger shield; the shield absorbs physical damage making you durable in fights.

void_spirit_astral_step.description: Steps through the void to a target location dealing damage and applying a void mark that slows.
void_spirit_astral_step.coaching_tip: Use both charges for burst damage and gap closing; save one charge for escape when playing aggressively.

warlock_fatal_bonds.description: Links several enemies together so that a portion of damage dealt to one is shared with all linked units.
warlock_fatal_bonds.coaching_tip: Cast before teamfight AoE damage to multiply your team's total output; pairs perfectly with Chaotic Offering.

warlock_shadow_word.description: Heals an ally or damages an enemy with a powerful DoT/HoT over time.
warlock_shadow_word.coaching_tip: Versatile as both heal and harass; the total value over duration is substantial for lane sustain.

warlock_upheaval.description: Channels an aura that increasingly slows enemies in the area.
warlock_upheaval.coaching_tip: Channel after Chaotic Offering for maximum slow stacking; the slow builds to near-immobilizing levels over time.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.description: Summons a golem that stuns on impact and persists as a powerful summon. Pierces spell immunity.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.coaching_tip: Fatal Bonds then Chaotic Offering is the classic combo; the BKB-piercing stun makes it a top-tier initiation.

weaver_the_swarm.description: Sends a swarm of beetles that latch onto enemies, reducing armor and dealing damage over time.
weaver_the_swarm.coaching_tip: The armor reduction stacks with each beetle attack; use to weaken targets before engaging with Geminate Attack.

weaver_shukuchi.description: Turns invisible and gains maximum movement speed, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
weaver_shukuchi.coaching_tip: Use for constant repositioning and damage; the short cooldown means you are invisible most of the time.

weaver_geminate_attack.description: Passively launches a second attack shortly after each attack.
weaver_geminate_attack.coaching_tip: Double attacks make on-hit items twice as effective; builds like Desolator are amplified by the extra hit.

weaver_time_lapse.description: Reverses Weaver's position and HP to where they were 5 seconds ago.
weaver_time_lapse.coaching_tip: Use after taking burst damage to restore full HP; also returns you to your position, so be aware of where you were 5s ago.

windrunner_shackleshot.description: Fires a shackle that stuns the target. If it latches to a tree or another enemy behind them, the stun is extended.
windrunner_shackleshot.coaching_tip: Always aim to latch to a tree or second hero for the full stun duration; without a latch it is a very short stun.

windrunner_powershot.description: Channels then fires a powerful shot that deals damage in a line, with damage reduced per unit hit.
windrunner_powershot.coaching_tip: Use to clear waves and snipe fleeing low-HP enemies; full channel deals maximum damage.

windrunner_windrun.description: Grants bonus movement speed and 100% evasion against physical attacks for a duration.
windrunner_windrun.coaching_tip: Activate to dodge all physical attacks; use for chasing, escaping, and surviving right-click damage.

windrunner_focusfire.description: Channels maximum attack speed on a single target with reduced damage per hit.
windrunner_focusfire.coaching_tip: Shackle a target then Focus Fire for massive single-target DPS; buy damage items to offset the damage reduction.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.description: Takes flight gaining bonus attack range and dealing burn damage based on enemy max HP.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.coaching_tip: The max HP burn is effective against tanky heroes; use the flight to attack from safe positions over terrain.

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.description: Fires a projectile at a target that splinters and damages all enemies around the target but not the target itself.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.coaching_tip: Target a unit near the enemies you want to damage; use creeps as the primary target to splash onto heroes.

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.description: Encases an ally in ice, healing them and making them immune to physical damage but unable to act.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.coaching_tip: Use to save allies from physical burst; be careful against magic damage since the target cannot move or act.

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.description: Curses an enemy causing their nearby allies to attack them. The cursed target is frozen.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.coaching_tip: Cast on a target surrounded by their allies for maximum damage from friendly fire; their own carry will kill the cursed target.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.description: Throws a cask that bounces between enemies, stunning each briefly.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.coaching_tip: Most effective against pairs of enemies where it bounces repeatedly; less effective against isolated single targets.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.description: Toggleable heal that continuously heals nearby allied units.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.coaching_tip: Toggle on during pushes and fights for sustained healing; watch your mana since it drains continuously.

witch_doctor_maledict.description: Curses enemies in an area, dealing burst damage every few seconds based on HP lost since the curse started.
witch_doctor_maledict.coaching_tip: Cast first then burst the target down; the more HP they lose during Maledict, the more bonus damage it deals.

witch_doctor_death_ward.description: Channels a powerful ward that attacks nearby enemies with high physical damage.
witch_doctor_death_ward.coaching_tip: Channel from hidden positions to avoid interruption; BKB protects the channel. Aghanim's adds bounce attacks.

skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.description: Fires a bolt that stuns, then slows and damages the target over time.
skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.coaching_tip: Reliable targeted stun for initiating ganks; the follow-up slow keeps enemies in melee range.

skeleton_king_mortal_strike.description: Grants a chance for critical strikes and summons skeletons from killed creeps.
skeleton_king_mortal_strike.coaching_tip: The crit chance makes WK a strong right-clicker; skeletons help with farming, pushing, and providing bodies in fights.

skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.description: Passively grants lifesteal to Wraith King and nearby allied heroes.
skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.coaching_tip: The aura sustains your team during fights and farming; stay near allies to share the lifesteal benefit.

skeleton_king_reincarnation.description: Upon death, Wraith King revives at the same location after a short delay, slowing nearby enemies.
skeleton_king_reincarnation.coaching_tip: The second life makes WK extremely hard to deal with; enemies must kill you twice. Ensure you have mana when diving.

zuus_arc_lightning.description: Strikes a target with chain lightning that bounces between enemies dealing magic damage.
zuus_arc_lightning.coaching_tip: Primary last-hitting and harass tool with very short cooldown; use constantly to pressure lane and farm.

zuus_lightning_bolt.description: Strikes a target with a bolt dealing heavy magic damage, briefly stunning and providing true sight.
zuus_lightning_bolt.coaching_tip: Use to deward and reveal invisible heroes with the true sight; high single-target burst for kill combos.

zuus_static_field.description: Every spell cast deals a percentage of nearby enemies' current HP as magic damage.
zuus_static_field.coaching_tip: Percentage-based damage is strong against tanky heroes; casting spells rapidly stacks the passive damage quickly.

zuus_thundergods_wrath.description: Strikes all enemy heroes globally with lightning dealing damage and providing brief vision.
zuus_thundergods_wrath.coaching_tip: Use to finish off fleeing low-HP enemies or reveal all enemy positions before a fight; pairs with Refresher for double ult.
